# SNOW｜外部行动者网络研究

研究截止：2026-10-18（UTC）。金额均为美元；产品状态按各项能力分别说明。无明确发布日期的技术文档作为截止日读取的动态资料，不据此重建其完整历史。

Snowflake 的外部网络围绕几项相互衔接的活动运作：客户取得预算和云资源，把业务数据及定义交给可执行的系统，再决定由谁完成查询、推理、事务处理和故障处置。企业采购部门、数据团队、应用开发者和运维团队可以分别作出选择。因而，合同额度、数据所在位置、用户界面和最终计算引擎需要分开识别；它们共同影响 Snowflake 的消费收入，但变化未必同向。

本轮新增材料把几条联系具体化：客户云承诺与 Snowflake 自身采购承诺是两份不同的经济安排；Databricks 联邦查询存在继续调用 Snowflake 和直接读取 Iceberg 两条路径；Fabric 镜像的分析分流与源端提取消费可以同时发生；Postgres 镜像已有 10 月 15 日 GA 公告；Sayari 的成本下降仍是客户预测。下文将公开事实、来源方主张和条件性推演分别表述，不将产品可接入性换算成客户收入或市场份额。

## 云承诺怎样变成可以部署的客户项目

企业财务与采购团队首先要解决预算归属、合同审批和已承诺云支出的使用。AWS 的 Marketplace 说明确认，符合条件的交易可以抵扣买方对 AWS 的支出承诺；private offer 则允许双方约定具体商业条款。这使原本走直销的软件采购有机会改走云渠道。适用资格仍取决于交易和客户合同，不能把所有 Snowflake 采购都视为自动抵扣。【cite:O113】[AWS 对合资格采购及续约的说明](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/awsmarketplace/private-offer-auto-renewals-scale-predictable-revenue-with-aws-marketplace/)

另一端是 Snowflake 自己向基础设施供应商采购。2026-05-27 公告称，公司作出五年 60 亿美元 AWS Graviton 计算及 AI 支出承诺，并扩大联合迁移、客户成功和 Marketplace 投入；公告称多数 Snowflake 客户运行在 AWS，渠道累计销售超过 70 亿美元。【cite:O57】[AWS 合作公告](https://www.snowflake.com/en/news/press-releases/snowflake-expands-aws-collaboration-with-6b-commitment-to-accelerate-enterprise-agentic-ai-adoption/) 前述企业买方承诺与这项 Snowflake 采购承诺的付款人、资源和用途不同，累计销售也没有给出当期净新增消费。

这套安排的作用是协调三种选择：客户决定把预算花在哪里，Snowflake 决定购买什么基础设施，AWS 决定提供何种资源和联合销售支持。研究推断：客户已有可抵扣预算时，Marketplace 可降低重新争取预算的摩擦；迁移资源和具体地区能力同时就绪，项目才更容易进入生产。若审批加快而模型或区域供给仍受限，效果先表现为签约或项目排队，尚不能传到使用收入。反之，供给扩大但客户缺少实施能力，也可能留下未充分利用的采购安排。

AWS、Azure 和 Google Cloud 还销售各自的数据与 AI 产品，既提供底层资源，也参与上层工作负载竞争。【cite:O53】【cite:O54】【cite:O55】客户转向云原生分析时，云厂商可能保留基础设施收入，而 Snowflake 的计算获配改变。因此云厂商总量增长对 Snowflake 同时包含供给、渠道和竞争含义。具体采购折扣、资源优先级及承诺利用率未披露，不能据协议金额推算单位成本下降。

可继续研究的外部事实来自 AWS Marketplace 的资格与交易机制、三家云的地区及服务资料，以及联合客户的迁移说明。渠道方掌握成交路径，客户和实施方掌握上线进度；两类资料解决的问题不同。尚未具名的转售商、分销商只保留为渠道类别，不据此补出名单或渠道收入占比。【cite:O58】

## 客户为何迁移，以及谁把迁移变成持续使用

Sayari 提供了一条从客户自身任务出发的联系。它在 2026-09-02 发布的公告称，选择 Snowflake 重建 Commercial World Model：整合来自 715 个来源、250 个司法辖区的 120 亿条记录，底层档案约有 10 亿份原始文件。其目标是从逐份文件的规则提取，转向利用整个档案中的上下文；CoCo 用于加速迁移。公告明确把基础设施成本下降超过 50% 写为公司预测，并称后续将推出基于该基础的新产品。【cite:O166】[Sayari 自行发布的项目公告](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sayari-rebuilds-its-commercial-world-model-on-snowflake-making-a-decade-of-deep-web-records-ai-ready-302868142.html)

这里的稀缺投入不只有计算。Sayari 需要持续取得原始记录、识别实体关系，并让结果可追溯；其分析人员还评估来源可靠性和不同地区的披露差异。【cite:O167】研究推断：如果新增 AI 产品使更多档案被反复处理、更新和查询，迁移可以形成后续生产消费；如果主要收益来自整合系统和降低单次处理成本，客户任务改善与 Snowflake 单位任务消费下降也可能同时发生。120 亿条记录描述的是数据资产范围，不是每季度重复计费任务量。

这也修正了对既有案例的读法：当前可确认选择、迁移工具使用和产品计划，不能把预计节省写为已实现结果，也不能从一次性迁移工作量推出续用曲线。后续产品是否实际推出、原始来源是否继续更新、哪些处理环节运行在 Snowflake，分别决定需求能否持续。客户自己的产品及架构资料最接近这些事实；厂商案例通常只能看到被选入发布材料的部分。

实施伙伴负责另一项协调工作：把旧数据模型、权限、应用接口和业务定义迁到可运行的状态。Deloitte 自身资料同时确认其 Snowflake 服务伙伴和 Databricks Global Elite 伙伴身份，说明同一家实施组织能够服务不同平台。【cite:O374】【cite:O375】[Deloitte—Snowflake](https://www.deloitte.com/us/en/alliances/snowflake.html)；[Deloitte—Databricks](https://www.deloitte.com/us/en/alliances/databricks-alliance.html)

因此，研究解释应把伙伴视为拥有交付能力和客户关系的独立参与者。它可以降低 Snowflake 项目实施障碍，也能帮助客户采用混合或替代架构。若项目从通用迁移转向业务流程重构，语义定义、验收和权限工作可能成为新的进度约束；咨询合同或合作头衔本身不能说明计算最终落在哪里。公开项目范围、客户上线说明和实际架构分工，比伙伴数量更能解释这条传导。

## 让同一业务定义服务多个界面，需要谁控制语义和身份

Indeed、Wix 的公开案例把 Semantic Views 与指标一致性、内部和面向客户的分析联系起来；这些引语由 Snowflake 发布，支持具体用途，但仍属于厂商托管的客户证据。【cite:O90】【cite:O96】数据团队维护“收入”“客户”等定义，业务人员从 BI、表格或 agent 发问，中间还需要目录发现、权限和工具能够理解定义。Alation 的目录连接、AtScale 的语义层连接和下游分析界面分别参与这些工作。【cite:O89】

Hex 在 2026-10-01 的自有材料中进一步区分“连接到表”和“复用指标定义”。其 Semantic Model Sync 可把 Snowflake 定义带入 Hex；但当时同步仍为 beta，支持范围尚不包含部分派生指标、内连接和视图内过滤。Hex 也说明，按用户 OAuth 执行与共享服务账户、数据抽取具有不同的权限含义。【cite:O144】【cite:O145】【cite:O147】[Hex 对语义兼容和身份的说明](https://hex.tech/blog/snowflake-semantic-views/)

研究推断：当定义确实由 Snowflake 维护、查询又以合适身份回到 Snowflake 执行时，第三方界面扩大的是同一数据基础的使用入口。若工具只导入一份定义后独立修改，客户会面对双份业务逻辑；若用一个服务身份服务所有用户，还需另行确认结果分享是否保持原有权限含义。兼容声明不能替代这两项判断。

这使某些外部变化具有明确作用。例如，Hex 增加原先不支持的语义构造，可能减少重建模型的工作，使更多现有定义可用；它先影响采用成本和可服务任务范围。能否进一步增加 Snowflake 消费，仍取决于查询执行和客户使用。反过来，第三方 agent 界面变得更受欢迎，并不自动意味着 Snowflake 计算流失；下一节和开放表章节中的路由安排才决定执行地点。

信息通常分别保存在语义工具的版本说明、OAuth/连接文档及客户的业务指标验收中。版本说明能确认兼容范围，客户或实施方才能确认定义是否真正一致。当前没有同一批客户的定义同步、查询量和付费使用联合数据，不能把 Indeed、Wix 与伙伴列名合并成独立的采用规模证据。

## 模型供给怎样穿过地区、权限和成本限制

Anthropic 与 OpenAI 为 Snowflake 提供模型接入及商业合作。双方分别公布的 2 亿美元合作规模说明有具体商业安排；但现有材料没有提供各期付款、资源分配或每客户消费，不能把两笔公布金额直接当成同期基础设施成本。Anthropic 所述经 Cortex 的 Claude 使用、Intercom Fin 案例，以及 Snowflake 所述 OpenAI 模型 GA，分别支持模型分销和工作负载连接。【cite:O71】【cite:O72】【cite:O75】【cite:O77】【cite:O98】

从模型提供商的位置看，Snowflake 是进入企业数据工作流的分销及治理入口；从客户的位置看，价值取决于允许使用的模型能否在其约束范围内完成任务。这两种解释不能用同一个 token 数量解决：更多调用可以表示任务扩大，也可以伴随更低单价、重复尝试或模型切换，现有资料无法给出净收入和毛利结果。

跨地区推理文档把一个容易混淆的依赖写清楚：客户数据仍存放在账户所在地区，但输入提示和输出响应可在处理期间暂时传到其他推理地区；客户通过账户参数限定允许的云和地理范围。关闭跨地区处理会把可选能力限制在本地区已部署的模型和功能。【cite:O100】【cite:O101】【cite:O103】[跨地区推理文档](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/snowflake-cortex/cross-region-inference)

因此，区域容量变化先影响的是符合该客户路由边界的可用供给。扩大其他地区的模型容量，对严格限制本地处理的账户未必有用；允许更广路由的客户则可能获得更多选择。存储驻留和推理处理地点必须同时核对。文档还称跨地区推理按请求账户地区计费且不另收该项数据出口费，不能把一般跨云传输费假设直接套到这一功能上。【cite:O104】这是一项产品处理安排，不能替代具体客户的法律或内部政策判断。

Cortex AI Gateway 则管理应用及第三方 agent 的模型调用、用量和审计，2026-09-15 资料标为 Preview，并明确其不扩大用户已有模型权限。【cite:O47】[Gateway 发布说明](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/release-notes/2026/other/2026-09-15-cortex-ai-gateway) 研究推断：模型可用、组织授权和成本可控是三个可分别阻断部署的环节。网关改善可见性以后，客户也可能主动减少低效调用。模型方发布和地区支持文档能够说明供给，账户路由配置及批准情况通常只有客户掌握；模型合作公告不能补出这一缺失连接。

## 数据继续留在原处时，查询究竟由谁执行

开放表把存储、目录、治理与计算的选择拆开。对 Databricks 和 Microsoft 而言，接入客户已有数据可以降低采用自家分析界面的障碍；对客户而言，混合架构可能避免立即迁走全部数据。但“联邦”“镜像”“零复制”描述的资源路径并不相同。

| 已核实的路径 | 实际作用 | 对 Snowflake 的经济联系 |
|---|---|---|
| Databricks query federation | JDBC 将查询操作下推到 Snowflake | 外部界面仍可带来 Snowflake 执行 |
| Databricks catalog federation | 合资格 Snowflake-managed Iceberg 表由 Databricks 直接读对象存储 | 该路径的查询计算由 Databricks 承担；非 Iceberg 表不适用 |
| Fabric 对原生托管表的镜像 | 将源数据复制到 OneLake，供 Fabric 分析 | 源端提取和下游查询可分处两个平台 |
| Fabric 对 Iceberg 表的镜像 | 同步元数据并以存储连接访问底层数据 | 数据位置保留不保证 Snowflake 查询获配 |

上述路径分别来自两家竞争者的技术文档，是功能连接证据，不是客户迁移规模。【cite:O269】【cite:O355】【cite:O118】[Databricks 查询联邦](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/query-federation/snowflake)；[目录联邦](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/query-federation/snowflake-catalog-federation)；[Fabric 镜像](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/mirroring/snowflake)

选择仍受对象类型和权限限制。Databricks 文档说明，不符合直接访问条件会回退 JDBC，视图查询也回到 Snowflake；所以新增目录连接数不能直接折成流失计算。【cite:O364】【cite:O365】Microsoft 则要求在 Fabric 重配源端细粒度安全；其限制文档还说明，提取持续运行，DDL 等变化触发的全量重载可能增加源端计算，某些禁止 inline URL 卸载的配置会阻断网关路径。【cite:O122】【cite:O132】【cite:O133】【cite:O135】[Fabric 限制与成本说明](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/mirroring/snowflake-limitations)

研究推断：一项 Fabric 上线既可能在迁移期增加 Snowflake 提取消费，又在以后把反复分析移到 Fabric。若只看到短期源端用量，就可能误判长期查询留存。相似地，Databricks 的新连接可能是互补调用，也可能是计算分流；应识别实际模式、表类型与回退情况，而非以界面品牌判断。

开放访问还要解决“谁执行权限”。Snowflake 的 Horizon Scan Plan API 通过向外部引擎提供已过滤的数据范围来执行行访问和列掩码；相关页面标为开放预览，要求兼容引擎及版本，受保护表写入也有策略模式限制。【cite:O168】【cite:O169】【cite:O170】[外部引擎策略执行](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/tables-iceberg-enforce-access-policies-scan-plan-api) 这为数据保留统一治理而计算分散提供一条路线，尚不能外推为所有引擎、读写和策略均无差异。

目录配置、查询计划、源端提取历史和目的端权限设置分别掌握在平台管理员及客户手中。公开文档能够识别可行路线和阻断点，公开客户架构才能说明实际分工。没有同一任务的执行与成本资料时，竞争者增长只能支持替代路线存在，不能代替 Snowflake 的净获配结果。

## 应用数据库如何把新鲜事务数据交给分析和 AI

Snowflake 收购 Crunchy Data 后，将其 Postgres 技术与团队用于 Snowflake Postgres；PostgreSQL 的工具和开发者生态降低了采用新服务时重写应用的部分负担，但不等于所有扩展、运维和地区条件一致。【cite:O80】【cite:O83】【cite:O84】客户需要同时解决应用事务可靠性和分析数据新鲜度，这与单纯迁移历史数据是不同的决策问题。

本轮找到 2026-10-15 官方公告，明确宣布 Postgres data mirroring GA，并列明 AWS、Azure 上 Snowflake Postgres 已运行的地区。这补充了此前仅依赖功能索引的阶段判断；部分技术页面仍显示 Preview，文档标识存在不一致，具体账户仍须按支持范围核对。【cite:O366】【cite:O370】[10 月 15 日 GA 公告](https://www.snowflake.com/en/blog/data-mirroring-ga-snowflake-postgres/)

其技术机制是从 Postgres 逻辑复制捕获变更，经 pg_lake 写入 Iceberg 变更日志，再由 Snowflake 任务应用到目标；目标与待应用变更组合的 live view 提供较新数据。技术文档列出的成本包括 serverless apply 计算和存储，刷新频率与处理量影响成本；镜像不能跨账户、地区或云创建。【cite:O294】【cite:O295】【cite:O299】【cite:O302】[镜像架构、成本及范围](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/snowflake-postgres/postgres-data-mirroring)

研究推断：客户减少的是自己部署、采购和维护中间 CDC 服务的工作，数据移动本身仍消耗资源。较低实施成本可以使原来因同步负担而搁置的分析进入生产；如果只是替换既有同步工具，收益先落在客户工程时间和第三方软件预算，Snowflake 净消费还取决于新增查询与同步效率。低延迟镜像也不是两个引擎共享同一个同步事务存储。

SimCorp 在 GA 公告中的引语把收益具体连接到债券定价所需信用利差数据的及时交付；这是客户引语，经 Snowflake 发布，未披露合同金额或同口径成本测试。【cite:O369】更有用的外部问题是：数据更新是否使客户业务能够采取原来无法及时采取的行动，而不只是复制更快。反向分析数据回传 Postgres 在公告中仍属后续方向，不能据当前单向镜像推定完整双向闭环。【cite:O372】

Lakebase 提供另一种应用数据库选择，其官方分支文档强调为开发、测试和试验创建隔离数据库分支。【cite:O345】[Lakebase 分支机制](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/oltp/projects/branches) 对需要大量隔离开发环境的团队，分支便利性可以参与选型；对已有 Snowflake 分析数据的团队，同账户镜像便利性可能更重要。这是按用途推导的竞争，而非性能胜负或实际失单。开发者资料、数据库迁移案例和客户生产架构，是区分这些选择的有效来源。

## 金融 agent 获得接口后，仍要取得数据内容和使用权

金融机构使用 agent，不仅需要模型和内部数据，还可能需要 FactSet、MSCI、Nasdaq eVestment 或新闻内容。Snowflake 的金融服务公告将这些来源与 MCP Server、Marketplace 和知识扩展连接起来。【cite:O51】【cite:O86】[金融服务产品公告](https://www.snowflake.com/en/news/press-releases/snowflake-unveils-cortex-ai-for-financial-services--enterprise-ready-ai-built-to-scale/) 内容提供商掌握覆盖、更新和授权；平台提供受治理的调用路径；客户决定谁可访问、如何把结果用于业务。这些角色不能由一种接口同时替代。

FactSet 自身的 2025-08-27 材料强调在连接层执行 entitlement、licensing 和可追溯性，且描述自有 API 和自然语言分析模块。【cite:O137】【cite:O138】[FactSet 对模块化工作流的说明](https://insight.factset.com/modular-ai-agents-and-the-new-operating-system-of-finance) 这说明数据供应方并非被动上传内容，也在控制访问和建设自己的分销界面。MCP 可减少工具之间的接口工作，实际可使用内容仍依赖供应方与客户的安排。

研究推断：若供应方扩大适合 AI 使用的内容或接口，先受益的是具有相应授权的客户工作流，随后才可能增加 Snowflake 上的检索、联结或推理。若供应方更改覆盖或访问条件，客户也可调整任务范围、使用其他数据源，或留在供应方自有工具中。当前没有各提供商与各客户的许可条款、调用结算和增量消费，不能把“接入某数据品牌”写成固定收入通道，也不能假定平台权限自动包含再分发等权利。

这里还需更新阶段口径：2025 年金融公告当时的 public preview，不代表截至本次截止日的 managed MCP server 仍处于该阶段；Snowflake 后续官方材料明确称 managed MCP server 已 GA。【cite:O378】[managed MCP server 的 GA 表述](https://www.snowflake.com/en/blog/intelligent-governed-ai-at-scale/) 服务器通用可用与每个数据产品、连接器及客户授权的可用性仍是不同事项。

供应商自有产品/API 资料最了解内容覆盖及访问机制，客户采购和技术团队最了解实际授权；Snowflake 公告确认平台连接。三者资料不能互相补造缺失的合同条款。有关数据内容的消息即使未提 Snowflake，也可先落到“受授权工作流的可服务范围是否变化”这一具体联系上。

## 从回答问题到修改业务系统，要经过哪些授权边界

MCP 的两种方向应明确区分。Snowflake-managed MCP server 把 Cortex Analyst、Search、Agents 等能力提供给外部客户端；当前文档要求服务器和各工具分别授权。另一方向的 MCP connector 则让 CoWork/Cortex Agents 调用 Jira、Salesforce 等远端工具，管理员配置集成后，用户仍需通过第三方 OAuth 认证。【cite:O382】【cite:O383】【cite:O418】【cite:O419】[managed server](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/snowflake-cortex/cortex-agents-mcp)；[外部 connectors](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/snowflake-cortex/cortex-agents-mcp-connectors)

Natoma 于 2026-06-03 完成收购，为 Snowflake 带入 MCP 连接与治理技术；收购公告中的跨 SaaS、云、VPC 和本地系统范围，包含后续整合方向，不能替代每项连接的当前验证。【cite:O60】【cite:O78】【cite:O79】在一个实际工作流中，业务负责人决定允许什么动作，系统管理员授予权限，远端 SaaS 提供并执行 API，agent 选择工具。任何一环收窄，都会改变可自动完成的任务。

广告工作流提供了边界清楚的例子。Snowflake 的 AI Gateway for Advertising 页面列出 Meta、TikTok 接口，以及在营销人员批准和策略约束下执行有边界动作的方向，并称产品为 Preview、PMG 为早期客户。【cite:O48】[广告 agent 工作流](https://www.snowflake.com/en/blog/ai-agents-in-advertising/) 因而当前支持的是特定预览路线和具名早期使用入口，尚无普遍生产部署或采购规模依据；连接列名也不等于广告平台向 Snowflake 授予独家商业分销。

协议制定者的资料解释了另一项真实约束：MCP 代理连接第三方 API 时，需要保留逐客户端同意，并禁止把未经正确验证的 token 直接透传。【cite:O307】【cite:O311】【cite:O313】[MCP 授权安全机制](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/2025-11-25/tutorials/security/security_best_practices) 这关系到谁能代表用户行动、下游如何识别调用者。它是协议实现边界，不能据此声称 Snowflake 或某个客户已经发生事故。Snowflake 的外部连接器文档也明确，远端服务器由客户负责核验其可信性和数据使用权。【cite:O421】

研究推断：远端工具改善可以扩大 agent 的任务范围，但部署是否推进取决于身份、权限和业务审批是否一起可用；若只能读取而不能写入，分析价值仍可保留，行动自动化的价值则收窄。若客户选择从第三方客户端调用 Snowflake，Snowflake 也可能继续提供数据和计算。工具目录、连接器文档和 SaaS 的授权资料能说明可执行范围，客户实际任务与审计记录才能说明完成率。连接数、工具调用数与最终成功业务动作没有已披露的统一换算关系。

## 遥测可以开放流动，运维工作流却不会自动迁移

Observe 要使客户把遥测数据和故障处理交给它，需要同时争取采购、数据导入和 SRE 工作流。Snowflake credits 可用于 Observe，降低一部分采购摩擦；但同一客户把既有承诺转用于 Observe，与购买更多总额度具有不同经济含义。【cite:O63】【cite:O64】Snowflake event tables 与 OpenTelemetry 兼容，官方文档同时列出 Observe 第一方路径、Datadog 集成和其他导出路线，说明开放遥测也能服务其他后端。【cite:O91】[Snowflake 遥测路由资料](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/developer-guide/native-apps/native-apps-third-party-observability)

Datadog 自有文档进一步表明，它支持 OpenTelemetry 及混合配置，部分功能取决于 SDK、Agent、Collector 等具体组合；其采样资料说明可在数据送入前减少 trace 数量，并将指标计算与采样顺序区分。【cite:O336】【cite:O337】[Datadog 的 OTel 兼容范围](https://docs.datadoghq.com/opentelemetry/compatibility/)；[采样与导入](https://docs.datadoghq.com/opentelemetry/ingestion_sampling/) 因此标准化降低的是接入和更换部分管道的成本，不会自动使告警、上下文、值班流程及功能覆盖一致。

Observe on Iceberg 的已核实范围仍为邀请制私有预览：客户 S3 bucket、每个 Data Lake 单一 AWS 区域，以及 Observe 写入的 Snowflake-managed Iceberg 表；外部引擎通过只读目录访问。这提供了将存储控制与查询选择拆开的路线，尚不支持任意自管表、多云或普遍商用的外推。【cite:O49】【cite:O50】新 Agent Observability 在 9 月 22 日材料中仍被描述为将进入私有预览；不能用其产品方向证明生产替换。【cite:O43】

从 SRE 的位置看，目标是可靠定位并处理故障，同时控制保留与查询成本。研究推断：客户可以先在不更换现有告警系统的情况下评估另一后端，也可减少采样后的导入量；原始遥测增长因而不必等比例传成平台收入。如果 Observe 获得持续数据导入但客户仍在 Datadog 处理关键事故，它取得的是部分工作负载。只有可靠性、功能覆盖和流程切换相继成立，才可能扩大预算分配；这些步骤可以分时发生。

这一网络与前述开放表及 agent 网络共用基础。更多 agent 调用增加需要解释的执行链，但网关优化和采样可能同时减少无效调用或被保留的数据；开放 Iceberg 则既能降低客户顾虑，也允许外部查询引擎参与。它们不能作为三份相互独立的收入增长证据。

Observe 文档最了解当前开放范围，Datadog 兼容资料最了解保留既有后端的可行性；客户 SRE 的迁移、并行运行和事故处理说明最接近真正的工作流选择。竞争者大客户增长可提供需求及既有工具基础的背景，尚不能说明 Observe 的获客或失单。当前缺少客户级持续导入、替换范围、净新增额度和续用资料，这些未知落在预算及工作流分配这一具体连接上。

这使某些外部变化具有明确作用。例如，Hex 增加原先不支持的语义构造，可能减少重建模型的工作，使更多现有定义可用；它先影响采用成本和可服务任务范围。能否进一步增加 Snowflake 消费，仍取决于查询执行和客户使用。反过来，第三方 agent 界面变得更受欢迎，并不自动意味着 Snowflake 计算流失；下一节和开放表章节中的路由安排才决定执行地点。

## 模型供给怎样穿过地区、权限和成本限制

Anthropic 与 OpenAI 为 Snowflake 提供模型接入及商业合作。双方分别公布的 2 亿美元合作规模说明有具体商业安排；但现有材料没有提供各期付款、资源分配或每客户消费，不能把两笔公布金额直接当成同期基础设施成本。Anthropic 所述经 Cortex 的 Claude 使用、Intercom Fin 案例，以及 Snowflake 所述 OpenAI 模型 GA，分别支持模型分销和工作负载连接。【cite:O71】【cite:O72】【cite:O75】【cite:O77】【cite:O98】

从模型提供商的位置看，Snowflake 是进入企业数据工作流的分销及治理入口；从客户的位置看，价值取决于允许使用的模型能否在其约束范围内完成任务。这两种解释不能用同一个 token 数量解决：更多调用可以表示任务扩大，也可以伴随更低单价、重复尝试或模型切换，现有资料无法给出净收入和毛利结果。

跨地区推理文档把一个容易混淆的依赖写清楚：客户数据仍存放在账户所在地区，但输入提示和输出响应可在处理期间暂时传到其他推理地区；客户通过账户参数限定允许的云和地理范围。关闭跨地区处理会把可选能力限制在本地区已部署的模型和功能。【cite:O100】【cite:O101】【cite:O103】[跨地区推理文档](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/snowflake-cortex/cross-region-inference)

因此，区域容量变化先影响的是符合该客户路由边界的可用供给。扩大其他地区的模型容量，对严格限制本地处理的账户未必有用；允许更广路由的客户则可能获得更多选择。存储驻留和推理处理地点必须同时核对。文档还称跨地区推理按请求账户地区计费且不另收该项数据出口费，不能把一般跨云传输费假设直接套到这一功能上。【cite:O104】这是一项产品处理安排，不能替代具体客户的法律或内部政策判断。

Cortex AI Gateway 则管理应用及第三方 agent 的模型调用、用量和审计，2026-09-15 资料标为 Preview，并明确其不扩大用户已有模型权限。【cite:O47】[Gateway 发布说明](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/release-notes/2026/other/2026-09-15-cortex-ai-gateway) 研究推断：模型可用、组织授权和成本可控是三个可分别阻断部署的环节。网关改善可见性以后，客户也可能主动减少低效调用。模型方发布和地区支持文档能够说明供给，账户路由配置及批准情况通常只有客户掌握；模型合作公告不能补出这一缺失连接。

## 数据继续留在原处时，查询究竟由谁执行

开放表把存储、目录、治理与计算的选择拆开。对 Databricks 和 Microsoft 而言，接入客户已有数据可以降低采用自家分析界面的障碍；对客户而言，混合架构可能避免立即迁走全部数据。但“联邦”“镜像”“零复制”描述的资源路径并不相同。

| 已核实的路径 | 实际作用 | 对 Snowflake 的经济联系 |
|---|---|---|
| Databricks query federation | JDBC 将查询操作下推到 Snowflake | 外部界面仍可带来 Snowflake 执行 |
| Databricks catalog federation | 合资格 Snowflake-managed Iceberg 表由 Databricks 直接读对象存储 | 该路径的查询计算由 Databricks 承担；非 Iceberg 表不适用 |
| Fabric 对原生托管表的镜像 | 将源数据复制到 OneLake，供 Fabric 分析 | 源端提取和下游查询可分处两个平台 |
| Fabric 对 Iceberg 表的镜像 | 同步元数据并以存储连接访问底层数据 | 数据位置保留不保证 Snowflake 查询获配 |

上述路径分别来自两家竞争者的技术文档，是功能连接证据，不是客户迁移规模。【cite:O269】【cite:O355】【cite:O118】[Databricks 查询联邦](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/query-federation/snowflake)；[目录联邦](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/query-federation/snowflake-catalog-federation)；[Fabric 镜像](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/mirroring/snowflake)

选择仍受对象类型和权限限制。Databricks 文档说明，不符合直接访问条件会回退 JDBC，视图查询也回到 Snowflake；所以新增目录连接数不能直接折成流失计算。【cite:O364】【cite:O365】Microsoft 则要求在 Fabric 重配源端细粒度安全；其限制文档还说明，提取持续运行，DDL 等变化触发的全量重载可能增加源端计算，某些禁止 inline URL 卸载的配置会阻断网关路径。【cite:O122】【cite:O132】【cite:O133】【cite:O135】[Fabric 限制与成本说明](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/mirroring/snowflake-limitations)

研究推断：一项 Fabric 上线既可能在迁移期增加 Snowflake 提取消费，又在以后把反复分析移到 Fabric。若只看到短期源端用量，就可能误判长期查询留存。相似地，Databricks 的新连接可能是互补调用，也可能是计算分流；应识别实际模式、表类型与回退情况，而非以界面品牌判断。

开放访问还要解决“谁执行权限”。Snowflake 的 Horizon Scan Plan API 通过向外部引擎提供已过滤的数据范围来执行行访问和列掩码；相关页面标为开放预览，要求兼容引擎及版本，受保护表写入也有策略模式限制。【cite:O168】【cite:O169】【cite:O170】[外部引擎策略执行](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/tables-iceberg-enforce-access-policies-scan-plan-api) 这为数据保留统一治理而计算分散提供一条路线，尚不能外推为所有引擎、读写和策略均无差异。

目录配置、查询计划、源端提取历史和目的端权限设置分别掌握在平台管理员及客户手中。公开文档能够识别可行路线和阻断点，公开客户架构才能说明实际分工。没有同一任务的执行与成本资料时，竞争者增长只能支持替代路线存在，不能代替 Snowflake 的净获配结果。

## 应用数据库如何把新鲜事务数据交给分析和 AI

Snowflake 收购 Crunchy Data 后，将其 Postgres 技术与团队用于 Snowflake Postgres；PostgreSQL 的工具和开发者生态降低了采用新服务时重写应用的部分负担，但不等于所有扩展、运维和地区条件一致。【cite:O80】【cite:O83】【cite:O84】客户需要同时解决应用事务可靠性和分析数据新鲜度，这与单纯迁移历史数据是不同的决策问题。

本轮找到 2026-10-15 官方公告，明确宣布 Postgres data mirroring GA，并列明 AWS、Azure 上 Snowflake Postgres 已运行的地区。这补充了此前仅依赖功能索引的阶段判断；部分技术页面仍显示 Preview，文档标识存在不一致，具体账户仍须按支持范围核对。【cite:O366】【cite:O370】[10 月 15 日 GA 公告](https://www.snowflake.com/en/blog/data-mirroring-ga-snowflake-postgres/)

其技术机制是从 Postgres 逻辑复制捕获变更，经 pg_lake 写入 Iceberg 变更日志，再由 Snowflake 任务应用到目标；目标与待应用变更组合的 live view 提供较新数据。技术文档列出的成本包括 serverless apply 计算和存储，刷新频率与处理量影响成本；镜像不能跨账户、地区或云创建。【cite:O294】【cite:O295】【cite:O299】【cite:O302】[镜像架构、成本及范围](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/snowflake-postgres/postgres-data-mirroring)

研究推断：客户减少的是自己部署、采购和维护中间 CDC 服务的工作，数据移动本身仍消耗资源。较低实施成本可以使原来因同步负担而搁置的分析进入生产；如果只是替换既有同步工具，收益先落在客户工程时间和第三方软件预算，Snowflake 净消费还取决于新增查询与同步效率。低延迟镜像也不是两个引擎共享同一个同步事务存储。

SimCorp 在 GA 公告中的引语把收益具体连接到债券定价所需信用利差数据的及时交付；这是客户引语，经 Snowflake 发布，未披露合同金额或同口径成本测试。【cite:O369】更有用的外部问题是：数据更新是否使客户业务能够采取原来无法及时采取的行动，而不只是复制更快。反向分析数据回传 Postgres 在公告中仍属后续方向，不能据当前单向镜像推定完整双向闭环。【cite:O372】

Lakebase 提供另一种应用数据库选择，其官方分支文档强调为开发、测试和试验创建隔离数据库分支。【cite:O345】[Lakebase 分支机制](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/oltp/projects/branches) 对需要大量隔离开发环境的团队，分支便利性可以参与选型；对已有 Snowflake 分析数据的团队，同账户镜像便利性可能更重要。这是按用途推导的竞争，而非性能胜负或实际失单。开发者资料、数据库迁移案例和客户生产架构，是区分这些选择的有效来源。

## 金融 agent 获得接口后，仍要取得数据内容和使用权

金融机构使用 agent，不仅需要模型和内部数据，还可能需要 FactSet、MSCI、Nasdaq eVestment 或新闻内容。Snowflake 的金融服务公告将这些来源与 MCP Server、Marketplace 和知识扩展连接起来。【cite:O51】【cite:O86】[金融服务产品公告](https://www.snowflake.com/en/news/press-releases/snowflake-unveils-cortex-ai-for-financial-services--enterprise-ready-ai-built-to-scale/) 内容提供商掌握覆盖、更新和授权；平台提供受治理的调用路径；客户决定谁可访问、如何把结果用于业务。这些角色不能由一种接口同时替代。

FactSet 自身的 2025-08-27 材料强调在连接层执行 entitlement、licensing 和可追溯性，且描述自有 API 和自然语言分析模块。【cite:O137】【cite:O138】[FactSet 对模块化工作流的说明](https://insight.factset.com/modular-ai-agents-and-the-new-operating-system-of-finance) 这说明数据供应方并非被动上传内容，也在控制访问和建设自己的分销界面。MCP 可减少工具之间的接口工作，实际可使用内容仍依赖供应方与客户的安排。

研究推断：若供应方扩大适合 AI 使用的内容或接口，先受益的是具有相应授权的客户工作流，随后才可能增加 Snowflake 上的检索、联结或推理。若供应方更改覆盖或访问条件，客户也可调整任务范围、使用其他数据源，或留在供应方自有工具中。当前没有各提供商与各客户的许可条款、调用结算和增量消费，不能把“接入某数据品牌”写成固定收入通道，也不能假定平台权限自动包含再分发等权利。

这里还需更新阶段口径：2025 年金融公告当时的 public preview，不代表截至本次截止日的 managed MCP server 仍处于该阶段；Snowflake 后续官方材料明确称 managed MCP server 已 GA。【cite:O378】[managed MCP server 的 GA 表述](https://www.snowflake.com/en/blog/intelligent-governed-ai-at-scale/) 服务器通用可用与每个数据产品、连接器及客户授权的可用性仍是不同事项。

供应商自有产品/API 资料最了解内容覆盖及访问机制，客户采购和技术团队最了解实际授权；Snowflake 公告确认平台连接。三者资料不能互相补造缺失的合同条款。有关数据内容的消息即使未提 Snowflake，也可先落到“受授权工作流的可服务范围是否变化”这一具体联系上。

## 从回答问题到修改业务系统，要经过哪些授权边界

MCP 的两种方向应明确区分。Snowflake-managed MCP server 把 Cortex Analyst、Search、Agents 等能力提供给外部客户端；当前文档要求服务器和各工具分别授权。另一方向的 MCP connector 则让 CoWork/Cortex Agents 调用 Jira、Salesforce 等远端工具，管理员配置集成后，用户仍需通过第三方 OAuth 认证。【cite:O382】【cite:O383】【cite:O418】【cite:O419】[managed server](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/snowflake-cortex/cortex-agents-mcp)；[外部 connectors](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/snowflake-cortex/cortex-agents-mcp-connectors)

Natoma 于 2026-06-03 完成收购，为 Snowflake 带入 MCP 连接与治理技术；收购公告中的跨 SaaS、云、VPC 和本地系统范围，包含后续整合方向，不能替代每项连接的当前验证。【cite:O60】【cite:O78】【cite:O79】在一个实际工作流中，业务负责人决定允许什么动作，系统管理员授予权限，远端 SaaS 提供并执行 API，agent 选择工具。任何一环收窄，都会改变可自动完成的任务。

广告工作流提供了边界清楚的例子。Snowflake 的 AI Gateway for Advertising 页面列出 Meta、TikTok 接口，以及在营销人员批准和策略约束下执行有边界动作的方向，并称产品为 Preview、PMG 为早期客户。【cite:O48】[广告 agent 工作流](https://www.snowflake.com/en/blog/ai-agents-in-advertising/) 因而当前支持的是特定预览路线和具名早期使用入口，尚无普遍生产部署或采购规模依据；连接列名也不等于广告平台向 Snowflake 授予独家商业分销。

协议制定者的资料解释了另一项真实约束：MCP 代理连接第三方 API 时，需要保留逐客户端同意，并禁止把未经正确验证的 token 直接透传。【cite:O307】【cite:O311】【cite:O313】[MCP 授权安全机制](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/2025-11-25/tutorials/security/security_best_practices) 这关系到谁能代表用户行动、下游如何识别调用者。它是协议实现边界，不能据此声称 Snowflake 或某个客户已经发生事故。Snowflake 的外部连接器文档也明确，远端服务器由客户负责核验其可信性和数据使用权。【cite:O421】

研究推断：远端工具改善可以扩大 agent 的任务范围，但部署是否推进取决于身份、权限和业务审批是否一起可用；若只能读取而不能写入，分析价值仍可保留，行动自动化的价值则收窄。若客户选择从第三方客户端调用 Snowflake，Snowflake 也可能继续提供数据和计算。工具目录、连接器文档和 SaaS 的授权资料能说明可执行范围，客户实际任务与审计记录才能说明完成率。连接数、工具调用数与最终成功业务动作没有已披露的统一换算关系。

## 遥测可以开放流动，运维工作流却不会自动迁移

Observe 要使客户把遥测数据和故障处理交给它，需要同时争取采购、数据导入和 SRE 工作流。Snowflake credits 可用于 Observe，降低一部分采购摩擦；但同一客户把既有承诺转用于 Observe，与购买更多总额度具有不同经济含义。【cite:O63】【cite:O64】Snowflake event tables 与 OpenTelemetry 兼容，官方文档同时列出 Observe 第一方路径、Datadog 集成和其他导出路线，说明开放遥测也能服务其他后端。【cite:O91】[Snowflake 遥测路由资料](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/developer-guide/native-apps/native-apps-third-party-observability)

Datadog 自有文档进一步表明，它支持 OpenTelemetry 及混合配置，部分功能取决于 SDK、Agent、Collector 等具体组合；其采样资料说明可在数据送入前减少 trace 数量，并将指标计算与采样顺序区分。【cite:O336】【cite:O337】[Datadog 的 OTel 兼容范围](https://docs.datadoghq.com/opentelemetry/compatibility/)；[采样与导入](https://docs.datadoghq.com/opentelemetry/ingestion_sampling/) 因此标准化降低的是接入和更换部分管道的成本，不会自动使告警、上下文、值班流程及功能覆盖一致。

Observe on Iceberg 的已核实范围仍为邀请制私有预览：客户 S3 bucket、每个 Data Lake 单一 AWS 区域，以及 Observe 写入的 Snowflake-managed Iceberg 表；外部引擎通过只读目录访问。这提供了将存储控制与查询选择拆开的路线，尚不支持任意自管表、多云或普遍商用的外推。【cite:O49】【cite:O50】新 Agent Observability 在 9 月 22 日材料中仍被描述为将进入私有预览；不能用其产品方向证明生产替换。【cite:O43】

从 SRE 的位置看，目标是可靠定位并处理故障，同时控制保留与查询成本。研究推断：客户可以先在不更换现有告警系统的情况下评估另一后端，也可减少采样后的导入量；原始遥测增长因而不必等比例传成平台收入。如果 Observe 获得持续数据导入但客户仍在 Datadog 处理关键事故，它取得的是部分工作负载。只有可靠性、功能覆盖和流程切换相继成立，才可能扩大预算分配；这些步骤可以分时发生。

这一网络与前述开放表及 agent 网络共用基础。更多 agent 调用增加需要解释的执行链，但网关优化和采样可能同时减少无效调用或被保留的数据；开放 Iceberg 则既能降低客户顾虑，也允许外部查询引擎参与。它们不能作为三份相互独立的收入增长证据。

Observe 文档最了解当前开放范围，Datadog 兼容资料最了解保留既有后端的可行性；客户 SRE 的迁移、并行运行和事故处理说明最接近真正的工作流选择。竞争者大客户增长可提供需求及既有工具基础的背景，尚不能说明 Observe 的获客或失单。当前缺少客户级持续导入、替换范围、净新增额度和续用资料，这些未知落在预算及工作流分配这一具体连接上。

expectation_baseline.name: Expansion with optimization, not a fixed core growth rate
expectation_baseline.baseline: Working operating inference: existing-customer expansion and completed migrations remain the main near-term core consumption engine, with efficiency and budget controls moderating credits per task. An expanding large-customer base and 126% platform NRR favor continuation over generalized retrenchment; neither identifies pure-core growth or a market-priced growth duration.
expectation_baseline.ordinary_progress: Additional workload cutovers, broader departmental usage and continued tuning of existing warehouses.
expectation_baseline.open_frontier: The net balance of new useful work, lower resource intensity and consumption diverted to other products or engines.

realization_factors.name: Business decisions generate recurring data work
realization_factors.mechanism: Useful business decisions, not stored bytes alone, generate core workload. Transaction/customer activity creates source changes; decision frequency and freshness requirements determine ingestion and refresh cadence; analytical complexity determines joins and transformations. Business teams can automate recurring investigations or reconciliations, increasing runs beyond analyst headcount. Administrators decide whether each run queries Snowflake live, reuses a cached result or works on an export, which determines core execution volume.
realization_factors.current_status: Existing data engineering and large-account expansion remain the practical base. Agent workflow capabilities create an additional demand source, while Sayari’s selected rebuild shows a customer seeking new uses for an existing information archive rather than merely storing more records. Working inference: useful refresh and decision frequency currently matter more than raw dataset accumulation.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Source-change volume sets ingestion scale; decision frequency can affect repeated processing within a quarter; freshness can multiply refresh work without increasing records. Complexity changes resources per run, whereas live-query allocation determines Snowflake participation. Holding other terms fixed, ten additional daily live reconciliations matter differently from ten cached answers; no fixed credits-per-decision coefficient is assumed. Large customers provide a broad expansion surface (828 above $1 million TTM platform spend), but that count is not a pure-core revenue denominator. New autonomous tasks may revise long-horizon opportunity before their near-term spending is material.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns incremental core preparation, refresh, query and collaboration consumption. Dedicated inference/orchestration belongs to the AI Unit; source-application spending is an external demand cause, not attributed Snowflake revenue.

realization_factors.name: Migration and customer rollout convert opportunity into consumption
realization_factors.mechanism: A customer starts with a workload inventory and platform choice. Conversion automation and implementation staffing shorten code work; validation, security acceptance and cutover determine when the workload actually moves. Departmental rollout and recurring workload retention then expand use. Acquisition and account expansion affect how many such projects enter the funnel; contract signatures precede consumption and do not fix its schedule.
realization_factors.current_status: Sayari is using CoCo on a substantial selected rebuild. Management’s September conference account describes migration time falling from roughly 10–11 to six months; this is an attributed example, not a fleet-wide delivery rate. Platform NRR at 126% and growth from 654 to 828 million-dollar TTM customers support an expanding base, while RPO fell sequentially despite year-over-year growth.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Inventory size and acquired/expanded accounts determine opportunity extent; win allocation determines participation; implementation throughput and cutover dates dominate near-term timing. A coding-time saving has little effect when customer validation is the critical path. Once live, rollout breadth and retention dominate recurring consumption and can outweigh the temporary migration burst. At the reported company-wide quarterly product scale of $1.492 billion, a 1% aggregate consumption change is about $14.9 million; this is a scale illustration, not an estimate of this Unit’s size. RPO of $9.0043 billion measures committed dollars, so shortening delivery time cannot be applied to it as if it were physical backlog.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns core customer acquisition, migration, rollout and retained workloads. Partner supply is explained in the cloud/channel Unit; this Factor retains the distinct core-demand consequence. Cash billing and collection remain in the finance Shell.

realization_factors.name: Execution efficiency and service-level choices reset paid intensity
realization_factors.mechanism: At a fixed useful workload, scan pruning, caching, right-sizing and scheduling reduce resources consumed. Standard warehouses charge for running capacity, so idle time and fragmentation matter as well as query duration. Adaptive execution changes allocation within an account. The customer’s latency target and concurrency tolerance determine how much saved capacity becomes a lower bill versus faster or more simultaneous work; lower cost can also unlock additional tasks.
realization_factors.current_status: Adaptive Compute is available and represents a real route to lower resource intensity, not merely a rival threat. The useful working reading is that inefficient and variable workloads have more optimization headroom than well-utilized ones. Savings are not assumed to transfer one-for-one into reduced consumption across the fleet.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Query work and idle capacity directly govern paid intensity; caching matters most for repeated answers, while resource pooling matters when workload peaks differ. Latency/concurrency policy controls the speed-versus-cost response. Near-term efficiency can lower consumption before new work ramps; over several quarters adoption elasticity can offset it. Illustratively, a 20% fall in credits per useful task requires 25% more tasks to keep credits unchanged (0.8×1.25=1); these are analytical assumptions, not measured savings. The current account-level headroom distribution is unmeasured, so benchmark improvement is not a platform-wide forecast.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Core consumption economics, not infrastructure supplier cost or profit margin. Adaptive account headroom is distinct from the hyperscaler’s regional physical headroom. Standard warehouse billing details do not imply identical serverless or AI billing.

realization_factors.name: Customer budgets, effective pricing and credit allocation shape net demand
realization_factors.mechanism: Finance owners set a data/AI budget and choose which useful tasks justify it. FinOps removes idle spend or low-value runs; effective price determines how much work the budget buys. Capacity commitments and remaining balances affect purchase urgency and renewal size but do not force immediate execution. Credits redirected to AI or Observe can reduce core use even when the company retains the customer. A lower price can preserve workload allocation while reducing revenue per unit.
realization_factors.current_status: Budget optimization and rollover are disclosed operating risks, not proof of generalized contraction. The wider FinOps survey describes pressure to fund AI from savings. With an expanding platform customer base and stable NRR, the best working explanation is competing growth and optimization, not indiscriminate core decline.
realization_factors.materiality_context: The budget ceiling has broad installed-base reach; task prioritization determines which real work disappears, while idle optimization can lower bills without harming output. Price acts immediately on revenue per credit but may improve future retention. Remaining balances and commitment term mainly shift renewal timing over quarters, rather than creating consumption themselves. Product reallocation is a direct subtraction from core but can be neutral to total platform spend. Since pure-core mix is unreported, the shared 126% NRR cannot distinguish these effects or be read as this quarter’s same-customer growth. Buyer savings and net new tasks must be evaluated together.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns spending appetite, capacity demand and effective consumption pricing. Gross margin, invoice timing and cash conversion are adjacent finance subjects; Observe’s actual workload economics remain in its own Shell.

realization_factors.name: Semantic reuse lowers the cost of analytical participation
realization_factors.mechanism: Data teams define trusted metrics and relationships; semantic compatibility lets BI tools and agents reuse them rather than rebuilding logic. Identity propagation preserves authorized results. Lower modeling and training effort broadens the participating departments and increases useful analytical requests; errors or divergent copies raise maintenance burden and inhibit repeat use. Query routing then decides whether broader participation produces Snowflake execution.
realization_factors.current_status: Indeed and Wix describe useful semantic adoption. Hex documents beta synchronization limits and identity-dependent access. Working inference: shared definitions lower a real adoption barrier, but semantic portability is partial and does not automatically eliminate tool-specific modeling.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Definition coverage determines the addressable question set; correctness and identity fidelity are acceptance gates; reuse effort and user accessibility govern rollout speed. Live execution is the capture variable. For current analytical users, removing duplicate modeling can accelerate departmental expansion within quarters; for unsupported definitions it has no immediate effect. More users alone are weaker than increased useful query frequency. Existing business definitions can support a wider opportunity than current seat counts, yet no independent revenue uplift from Semantic Views has been measured.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Explains core self-service and data engineering use. AI-answer acceptance is developed in the AI Unit, and control-plane bargaining power in the competitive Unit; these are distinct outcomes of the same assets.

realization_factors.name: Shared operational data creates reuse without requiring duplicate storage
realization_factors.mechanism: Data providers grant access to useful content and consumers combine it with their own operating data. Freshness and recurring application use determine repeat queries; entitlement and cross-organization controls define the accessible audience. In native sharing the consumer can query without storing another copy. Eliminating replicated copies can reduce storage and pipeline work even while broader access generates additional compute.
realization_factors.current_status: Salesforce’s zero-copy relationships supply an application entry point; Snowflake native sharing provides a technical route from access to consumer compute. The working model is complementary recurring analysis plus avoided duplication, not a network effect that guarantees additional revenue for every new share.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Content usefulness and entitled audience set reach; freshness and application frequency determine recurrence; query placement governs compute capture. Avoided copies reduce storage immediately, while new consumers may ramp gradually. A widely shared but rarely queried dataset has less consumption leverage than a narrow daily operational input. Provider preparation can persist even if consumer queries move elsewhere. The sign is therefore positive for useful access but mixed for total resource use, with no defensible universal dollars-per-share multiple.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns general data collaboration and related core execution. Financial content rights that gate AI tasks are maintained in the AI Unit. Cross-region replication, reader accounts and other sharing modes may have different payer/cost arrangements from native same-region sharing.

realization_factors.name: Trust and access controls govern workload continuity
realization_factors.mechanism: Customer credentials, service identities and third-party integrations determine authorized data access. An incident or tighter access policy can suspend sharing and project onboarding; remediation and usable least-privilege controls restore continuity. Buyers distinguish platform integrity from a compromised customer or communication system, but uncertainty itself can raise approval friction and switching consideration.
realization_factors.current_status: The October ASOS record does not establish a Snowflake platform breach: messaging-platform unauthorized activity was confirmed, while Snowflake denied a platform compromise. The current model is exposure to access-policy and trust shocks, not an inference of existing platform failure or a cause assigned to the share-price decline.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Access revocation can immediately stop the affected workload; incident perimeter determines whether the reach is one integration, a customer or wider procurement. Remediation duration shifts delivery timing, while confidence and switching costs govern longer-run retention. Credentials and third-party access are potentially high-leverage gates even when resource demand is strong. Conversely, a contained messaging event need not change query demand at all. No breach-loss, churn or outage coefficient is assigned from an unverified allegation.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Core usage and customer trust consequences only. Security expenditure, legal liabilities and company cash outcomes belong to adjacent ownership; tool-write authorization is a separate AI workflow mechanism.

potential_gaps.name: Recurring business activity changes the core workload ceiling
potential_gaps.why_live: Large-account expansion supplies an installed base, while existing agents and customer data rebuilds make work beyond traditional dashboard use technically plausible. The current expansion baseline does not assume every business decision becomes a live warehouse query.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The outlook changes if customers move from periodic reports to recurring machine-assisted decisions, or instead reduce human analytical activity. The key distinction is newly created preparation/refresh/query work versus reused answers; dedicated AI inference is not counted here.

possibility_space.name: Finance teams delegate recurring reconciliations and investigations
possibility_space.implication: Scheduled work can add refreshes, joins and exception queries independent of analyst seats, extending the core consumption opportunity beyond the current human-use ceiling.

possibility_space.name: Customer-service and risk teams require current operational context
possibility_space.implication: Repeated decisions using fresh orders, transactions or entity relationships can raise data-engineering cadence before the number of stored records changes materially. This can compound the finance-workflow route rather than replace it.

possibility_space.name: Companies replace repeated dashboard exploration with reusable answers
possibility_space.implication: Fewer human exploratory queries and more precomputed summaries can offset new agent questions. A broader end-user population would then overstate incremental paid core work.

possibility_space.name: Automation savings finance additional analytical products
possibility_space.implication: Cheaper business operations can support more customer-facing data products rather than merely cost reduction. Core demand expands only to the extent these products retain live Snowflake preparation and execution.

potential_gaps.name: Migration acceleration changes timing and retained workload quality
potential_gaps.why_live: Sayari is a named selected rebuild using CoCo. Management describes shorter migration timelines, but validation and customer cutover remain separate from code conversion; RPO is not a physical delivery schedule.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The working path is continuing migrations and account expansion. Faster delivery can pull consumption forward, but its enduring significance depends on what remains after migration work and whether customers broaden or rationalize their workloads.

possibility_space.name: Customers standardize automated conversion and validation
possibility_space.implication: Repeatable testing as well as coding brings production cutovers forward and increases the number of projects the ecosystem can deliver, not merely temporary migration compute.

possibility_space.name: Security or business acceptance becomes the new queue
possibility_space.implication: Conversion improves while customer approvals remain slow. The near-term consumption acceleration is smaller than the coding productivity gain, even if the long-run opportunity survives.

possibility_space.name: A large migration ends in a leaner production architecture
possibility_space.implication: Cutover produces an initial burst followed by optimized steady use. Successful delivery can therefore coincide with weaker subsequent consumption than a migration-period extrapolation.

possibility_space.name: A migrated estate becomes the starting point for new departments
possibility_space.implication: Once the common data foundation is accepted, subsequent business units can reuse it with lower deployment effort. Retained expansion becomes more important than the original cutover date.

potential_gaps.name: Useful work and paid core consumption diverge
potential_gaps.why_live: Adaptive execution, customer optimization and internal competition for data/AI budgets are already part of the operating system. The shared revenue and retention anchors do not isolate pure-core task volume, price or product reallocation.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The baseline allows expansion moderated by efficiency. A change in customer operating policy or effective price can alter credits and revenue without a proportionate change in useful work; rebound demand and product reallocation determine whether the effect persists.

possibility_space.name: Customers pool variable workloads and bank the savings
possibility_space.implication: Broad adoption of efficient execution lowers idle and oversized capacity at a fixed workload. Revenue intensity can decline even with healthy customer output and retention.

possibility_space.name: Business teams spend saved capacity on tighter service levels
possibility_space.implication: Faster responses, more concurrency or more frequent refreshes absorb some savings. The same technical efficiency improvement then changes output more than total consumption.

possibility_space.name: CFOs redirect analytical budgets into AI or telemetry
possibility_space.implication: Core spend can weaken while Snowflake retains the customer and total platform spending remains firm. This revises core demand, not necessarily company-wide demand.

possibility_space.name: Customer budgets contract or low-value reporting is eliminated
possibility_space.implication: Useful workload frequency itself falls, a different deterioration from removing idle resources. Shorter commitments and unused balances can delay subsequent capacity purchases.

possibility_space.name: Snowflake changes effective prices or storage/compute packaging
possibility_space.implication: Lower customer prices may defend workload allocation while reducing near-term revenue per resource; a broader affordable workload set can improve later adoption. Price and physical efficiency must not be treated as the same change.

potential_gaps.name: Governed participation expands through semantics and shared data
potential_gaps.why_live: Indeed and Wix describe semantic reuse; BI compatibility is partial. Native sharing and application zero-copy links provide separate routes to widen the users and data involved in recurring work.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The current model expects gradual departmental use, not frictionless universal access. Better reuse can change the addressable question set and the number of recurring consumers; avoided copies and external execution can offset some resource growth.

possibility_space.name: BI tools preserve richer definitions and per-user identity
possibility_space.implication: More departments can reuse trusted metrics without duplicating models. Live Snowflake execution can expand even when the visible front end is another vendor.

possibility_space.name: Semantic copies drift across tools
possibility_space.implication: Organizations retain conflicting definitions or require manual remapping. Self-service rollout slows and more tooling does not translate into proportionately more useful core queries.

possibility_space.name: Application owners make shared operational datasets a standard input
possibility_space.implication: Repeated service, personalization or supplier decisions expand consumer compute and cross-company analysis without requiring a full data migration.

possibility_space.name: Zero-copy adoption mainly removes redundant pipelines
possibility_space.implication: A genuine customer productivity gain can reduce duplicated storage and ingestion before new query activity ramps. Connectivity growth alone would overstate consumption growth.

potential_gaps.name: Access-policy shocks interrupt or strengthen workload continuity
potential_gaps.why_live: Third-party identities and service credentials gate useful access. The ASOS record contains a messaging-system incident and a denied/unverified Snowflake-platform allegation, not an established Snowflake breach.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The continuation view assumes authorized workloads remain usable. A change in trust, credential policy or remediation can alter onboarding and retention before any engine capability changes; the perimeter of the problem determines its reach.

possibility_space.name: A verified identity or integration incident prompts access suspensions
possibility_space.implication: Affected customers can halt sharing or delay projects even without an engine defect. A broad administrative response matters more than the original application’s size.

possibility_space.name: Enterprises require least-privilege access that integrations cannot preserve
possibility_space.implication: Stricter controls narrow the feasible user and service population. Deployment can slow despite intact customer demand and available compute.

possibility_space.name: Remediation makes governed access easier to approve
possibility_space.implication: Improved identity propagation and usable controls can restore suspended workloads or favor a controlled platform over ad hoc copies. This is an access and trust change, not proof that a prior platform compromise occurred.

expectation_baseline.name: Broader governed use, uneven production depth
expectation_baseline.baseline: Working inference: enterprise AI use should broaden across coding, analysis and selected operational tasks over the next few quarters. Reported activity and working customer cases support more than a demonstration market, but retained paid depth will remain uneven because data context, authorization and completed-task economics differ by workflow. This is not an AI-revenue forecast or a statement of consensus.
expectation_baseline.ordinary_progress: More users within approved tasks, new integrations and incremental production deployment alongside continuing trials.
expectation_baseline.open_frontier: Whether recurring operational tasks and existing cohorts deepen fast enough to offset one-time migration work and cheaper execution.
expectation_baseline.time_scope: Quarterly adoption through the next annual deployment cycle

realization_factors.name: Operational usefulness and buyer authorization create retained AI work
realization_factors.mechanism: Business owners adopt an agent when avoided labor, faster decisions or improved service outweigh supervision and implementation effort. They choose the task perimeter, recurrence and human checkpoints. Successful deployment converts trial activity into retained production tasks; coding and migration tools may instead have a finite project life. Departmental expansion increases breadth, while task frequency and duration determine use depth.
realization_factors.current_status: CoCo and CoWork have reported weekly usage, but the population mixes use types and is not a paid cohort. External finance-agent templates demonstrate scheduled operational possibilities. Working inference: coding and approved analytical tasks offer the easiest initial adoption, while broad recurring operational ownership develops unevenly rather than automatically from account growth.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Useful task inventory sets opportunity; the accountable budget owner and approval determine adoption; recurrence, success rate and retention determine durable volume. Supervision can dominate economics for error-sensitive decisions even if inference is cheap. More than 9,100 CoCo active accounts and approximately 5,800 CoWork accounts establish distribution breadth, not task depth. One high-frequency production workflow can consume more than many trial accounts. Existing-cohort retention therefore has greater immediate revenue-reading leverage than new registrations, while new autonomous task classes may have greater long-horizon revision value. No account-to-revenue conversion is assumed.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns AI task demand, adoption and retained use; associated core SQL/preparation belongs to core consumption. Labor savings are customer value, not automatically Snowflake revenue or a company margin benefit.

realization_factors.name: Context and evaluation make model capability deployable
realization_factors.mechanism: Model reasoning is useful only with relevant, fresh, entitled data and consistent business definitions. Retrieval coverage and semantic structure determine what questions can be answered; evaluations expose error types and guide remediation. Business owners accept production only when residual error and review effort fit the task’s consequences. Better models can reduce failures, but cannot supply a missing proprietary definition or authorize unavailable data.
realization_factors.current_status: Governed data and existing Semantic Views give Snowflake a practical advantage for tasks near its customer data. Indeed and Wix support the usefulness of consistent definitions, while cross-tool compatibility limits show incomplete coverage. Working inference: context and evaluation are currently more binding than access to yet another frontier model for many enterprise-specific questions.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Model competence sets the feasible reasoning envelope; data coverage/freshness and definitions determine factual/task reach; error rate and review burden control production acceptance. These are not interchangeable substitutes: improving the model has little impact on an unlicensed or semantically ambiguous input. Evaluations add work initially but can unlock repeated approved tasks. The potential reach extends across existing data estates, yet the marginal payoff is greatest on recurring, consequential questions with well-defined ground truth; open-ended questions retain higher review burden. No measured fleet-wide accuracy or conversion uplift is available.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: AI task success and acceptance. The core Unit owns the additional queries; the competitive Unit owns whether portable semantics preserves platform power. Governance is not asserted to guarantee answer correctness.

realization_factors.name: Default interfaces divide orchestration from backend capture
realization_factors.mechanism: Productivity suites, model providers and Snowflake compete to be the user’s default agent interface. Distribution and incremental purchase friction influence which orchestrator receives a task. The orchestrator then chooses models and tools: it can call Snowflake’s governed services, issue core queries only, or use another backend. Control of session context, tool selection and billing divides the value among client, orchestration, inference and data execution.
realization_factors.current_status: Microsoft’s March Copilot Cowork arrangement and Anthropic’s own workflow clients provide credible alternatives. Snowflake managed MCP permits external clients, so losing the front end is not identical to losing the backend. The working model is distributed capture, rather than either guaranteed Snowflake full-stack monetization or inevitable disintermediation.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Default distribution influences task reach quickly across existing users; purchase friction and enterprise standardization affect adoption pace. Tool routing determines Snowflake participation; orchestration/model choice determines which AI services it captures. A third-party interface that sends more governed queries can help core consumption while leaving Snowflake AI orchestration flat. Conversely, native-interface growth can remain shallow if tasks run elsewhere. Current active-account metrics cannot separate these layers, making allocation more informative than combined enterprise agent activity. Channel power can revise future market access before a quarter’s revenue changes.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: AI-product capture, not overall platform market share. The competitive Unit covers whole-platform budget consolidation; core consumption retains the separate consequence of backend SQL calls.

realization_factors.name: Content entitlement controls the serviceable task perimeter
realization_factors.mechanism: Data owners choose coverage, freshness, permitted AI uses and commercial terms. Connector availability reduces integration work, but customer entitlement determines which content the agent can actually retrieve or reuse. Providers may distribute through multiple agents or preserve valuable workflows in their own products. Customers substitute content or task scope when rights or access costs change.
realization_factors.current_status: Financial-data connections are available, and FactSet explicitly emphasizes entitlement and licensing. The best working explanation is a permissioned, nonexclusive content network: adding a provider name expands possible tasks, but does not make every customer eligible or assign the task’s economic value to Snowflake.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Unique content and freshness determine differentiated task value; rights are a hard gate; integration effort primarily affects deployment speed. Provider pricing affects customer willingness to run the task and the residual budget available to platform services. A restricted critical dataset can block a high-value workflow even with abundant models; broader rights can release that workflow without new model engineering. Multi-homing reduces exclusive capture and increases substitution options. The effect is concentrated in content-dependent tasks, not all coding or internal-data analysis, and no uniform spend-through ratio is established.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: AI content access and task demand. Provider content fees are not assumed to be Snowflake product revenue. Public rule changes matter through specific rights and uses, not a generic legal risk score.

realization_factors.name: Delegated actions and approval rules define operational autonomy
realization_factors.mechanism: SaaS/API owners expose possible actions; administrators configure tools and identities; users grant delegated access; business owners choose approval, audit and rollback policies. Together these determine whether an agent can read, recommend or execute. A successful write can close an operational workflow; denied permissions, unsafe actions or mandatory review can leave it as a decision-support assistant. Public requirements and internal risk standards influence that approval perimeter.
realization_factors.current_status: Outbound connectors require remote authorization; advertising actions remain bounded preview workflows. Managed MCP inbound access and outbound action access are different directions. Current operation is controlled, task-specific delegation rather than unrestricted autonomy, and external consent cannot be replaced by platform privileges.
realization_factors.materiality_context: API/action scope sets functional reach; identity and content authority are binary gates; business approval and rollback determine acceptable autonomy. Review latency can be the dominant limit for consequential writes even when model latency is low. Broader authority increases task completion and potential recurrence, but can also increase failure handling and governance work. Routine low-risk actions may scale within quarters; sensitive financial, personnel or external-facing actions can require longer organizational change. The material scale is completed workflows, not the number of connectors. Regulatory changes can alter eligibility before usage appears, but no blanket classification of all agent tasks is made.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: AI workflow capability and deployability, including external public decisions. Core access continuity is separate from permission to alter remote systems; company legal liabilities and compliance costs are adjacent finance subjects.

realization_factors.name: Completed-task economics govern paid intensity and adoption elasticity
realization_factors.mechanism: A completed task consumes model context/output, retrieval, orchestration and tools; retries and repeated context add work without necessarily adding value. Model choice, caching and narrower tool payloads can reduce cost or latency. Customer quotas and budgets constrain runs; lower cost per useful completion can stimulate new tasks. Snowflake capture depends on which components it supplies and their service-specific metering, not a single uniform token multiplier.
realization_factors.current_status: Caching and token-saving techniques are feasible externally; Snowflake gateway and usage controls support deliberate optimization. The useful working view is rising task adoption with uncertain paid intensity: better task quality can retain users while fewer retries and cheaper routes reduce consumption per success. Current dynamic documentation is a technical premise, not a retrospective assertion that every service had the same rate on the cutoff date.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Task count and duration set gross activity; model mix and context size set inference intensity; retries reduce success-adjusted economics; tool/query use and routing determine additional Snowflake capture. Quotas cap spend immediately, while lower latency can improve adoption over quarters. A hypothetical 30% reduction in metered units per task needs roughly 43% more tasks to preserve those units; it does not establish revenue neutrality when prices or mix also change. Production recurrence is currently a more important unknown than token list prices because AI revenue and paid cohorts are unreported. Vendor input costs and customer savings must not be treated as identical.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: AI paid-consumption and customer value relationships. Core SQL is connected but not double-counted as AI revenue; model procurement, GPU cost and gross margin belong to finance.

potential_gaps.name: AI adoption becomes persistent operational responsibility
potential_gaps.why_live: Reported CoCo and CoWork activity establishes breadth but not retained paid depth. Existing workflow templates and customer cases make recurring production tasks plausible; finite migrations can also inflate early activity.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The baseline is broader but uneven governed use. A shift in who owns a task, how often it recurs and whether it survives its initial project changes the persistence of AI consumption, not merely account count.

possibility_space.name: Business owners give agents scheduled recurring work
possibility_space.implication: Named operational responsibility and repeat tasks create a more durable consumption base than occasional assistance, potentially extending adoption across an existing account.

possibility_space.name: Customers finish migrations and stop using the coding tool
possibility_space.implication: A successful one-time project can leave a weaker AI cohort even while core production use grows. This separates AI retention from migration success.

possibility_space.name: Organizations keep agents as supervised productivity tools
possibility_space.implication: Useful human assistance expands but may remain intermittent and low intensity. More weekly users need not imply autonomous-workload economics.

possibility_space.name: A service provider runs workflows on customers’ behalf
possibility_space.implication: Operational outsourcing can concentrate task ownership, procurement and platform selection in a smaller number of providers. Snowflake may gain recurring backend work or lose customer-level orchestration capture depending on the provider’s stack.

potential_gaps.name: The default work interface redirects AI-product capture
potential_gaps.why_live: Productivity suites and model providers offer their own agent surfaces; Snowflake managed MCP lets external clients call governed capabilities. Interface adoption and backend allocation are already separable.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The current distributed-capture view can change if a default interface becomes the enterprise standard, if it retains Snowflake as a tool, or if it supplies a substitute execution path. Enterprise agent demand is not the same as Snowflake AI demand.

possibility_space.name: A suite makes agents part of the standard employee experience
possibility_space.implication: Lower purchasing and training friction can expand task volume rapidly. Snowflake benefits only in the service layers that the suite actually calls.

possibility_space.name: External clients standardize on Snowflake’s governed AI tools
possibility_space.implication: Snowflake can retain AI execution and context value without owning the interface; external distribution then becomes a complementary channel.

possibility_space.name: Clients call only SQL or route inference directly to model providers
possibility_space.implication: Core queries may persist while Snowflake orchestration or model-service capture weakens. Backend data retention is not full-stack AI monetization.

possibility_space.name: Customers choose Snowflake-native workflows to consolidate governance
possibility_space.implication: A simpler approved control environment can favor native orchestration over a fragmented stack, especially where proprietary data context is central.

potential_gaps.name: Content owners redraw the AI task market
potential_gaps.why_live: Financial tasks depend on licensed, current content as well as models. FactSet’s entitlement focus and multiple provider distribution routes make access rights an independent constraint.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The working reference is a permissioned, nonexclusive network, not universal access through any connector. Rights, price and distribution choices can expand useful tasks or reserve their value for another platform before Snowflake product usage changes.

possibility_space.name: Providers broaden machine-usable rights and governed connectors
possibility_space.implication: Entitled customers can automate more content-dependent work, enlarging retrieval, joins and reasoning opportunities without a new frontier-model capability.

possibility_space.name: Providers reserve valuable workflows or restrict reuse
possibility_space.implication: Some tasks become costlier or unavailable through Snowflake, while direct-provider applications retain the relationship. Connector presence would then overstate serviceable demand.

possibility_space.name: Customers substitute content or narrow the task
possibility_space.implication: Work can continue on different sources or with reduced coverage. The platform may retain activity but lose differentiated high-value use, rather than experience a binary adoption stop.

potential_gaps.name: Correctness and delegated authority redefine the production perimeter
potential_gaps.why_live: Semantic assets can improve task grounding, while incompatible definitions, external OAuth and business approvals remain distinct limits. Advertising actions are bounded preview workflows, not general autonomous control.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The current baseline favors approved coding and analytical work. Better answers and broader action authority can each enlarge the feasible task set; one does not automatically supply the other. Public and internal standards can shift the acceptable perimeter in either direction.

possibility_space.name: Enterprises validate reusable context and evaluations for consequential tasks
possibility_space.implication: Lower ambiguity and review burden can move repeated questions into production. This changes adoption even if the model itself is unchanged.

possibility_space.name: Better reasoning exposes missing definitions or stale data
possibility_space.implication: Users attempt broader tasks but hit a context boundary. Deployment effort shifts to data ownership and modeling, and model improvement alone produces less paid expansion than expected.

possibility_space.name: SaaS owners permit delegated writes with reliable rollback
possibility_space.implication: Agents can complete approved workflows rather than merely recommend actions. The addressable operational task range expands, with new retries and tool work as well as customer value.

possibility_space.name: An incident or stricter rule forces human approval or read-only operation
possibility_space.implication: Useful analytical assistance may survive, but autonomous task completion and recurrence narrow. The effect differs by task consequence and jurisdiction rather than applying uniformly to all agents.

potential_gaps.name: Cheaper useful completions change both demand and monetization
potential_gaps.why_live: Caching, model routing and usage controls can reduce paid intensity; repeated context and failed loops consume resources without comparable value. Current account disclosures do not isolate these effects.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The baseline of growing use does not fix revenue per successful task. Efficiency, customer budgeting and commercial design can redistribute gains between more completed work, lower bills and different service providers.

possibility_space.name: Gateway teams cache context and eliminate unnecessary loops
possibility_space.implication: Consumption per completed task falls at fixed useful activity. Improved quality can strengthen retention even as metered units decline.

possibility_space.name: Lower cost and latency make previously uneconomic tasks recurring
possibility_space.implication: New high-frequency use can absorb efficiency savings and enlarge the AI opportunity. The relevant comparison is task expansion against lower intensity, not tokens alone.

possibility_space.name: Customers impose hard quotas or consolidate model spending
possibility_space.implication: Task growth becomes budget-bound, and cheaper model routes can displace richer service mix. Growing demand may then change allocation rather than total spending.

possibility_space.name: Vendors compete on predictable or outcome-linked contracts
possibility_space.implication: Buyers may adopt more readily when spending risk shifts toward providers. Platform capture then depends on what is bundled and who bears unsuccessful-run costs; this is a possible commercial change, not an asserted Snowflake pricing plan.
