expectation_baseline.name: Hybrid allocation rather than automatic winner-take-all
expectation_baseline.baseline: Working inference: the next procurement cycle will remain a contest between integrated platforms and mixed-engine architectures. Paid rival adoption makes substitution substantive; open access and the cost of replacing semantics and controls favor staged allocation over an immediate wholesale exit. Neither direction establishes a net Snowflake share change.
expectation_baseline.ordinary_progress: Additional federation, mirror and governance integrations plus project-by-project platform decisions.
expectation_baseline.open_frontier: The mix of source extraction and persistent query execution, and which platform controls budget and business context.

realization_factors.name: Open formats unbundle data retention from query allocation
realization_factors.mechanism: Table format, catalog mode and object eligibility determine which engines can access data. The customer chooses query routing based on total execution cost, performance and tool needs. JDBC can push work to Snowflake; direct storage reads move that work to another engine; mirroring adds extraction followed by destination queries. Views, unsupported objects or access constraints can force fallback. These paths allow customer data to remain while recurring compute shifts.
realization_factors.current_status: Databricks and Fabric offer distinct operational routes, while Snowflake’s Iceberg capability expands external-data opportunities. The current reading is selective contestability, not uniform bypass: eligibility and actual execution mode matter more than the brand of the interface.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Eligible workload coverage sets the addressable shift; routing is the direct capture variable; repeated-query frequency sets its economic size. Extraction can initially increase source consumption while later reads move away, so timing can reverse the apparent sign. Relative performance/cost influences routing but only inside the eligible set; fallback protects some native work. A frequently repeated eligible workload has more leverage than a large static table never queried. Rival adoption establishes a real alternative market but not the fraction of Snowflake’s $1.492 billion quarterly product revenue exposed. No transfer coefficient is inferred from catalog connections.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns compute allocation and switching architecture. Core Unit owns resulting usage; governance power is maintained separately so control-plane retention is not mistaken for compute retention.

realization_factors.name: Policy and semantic portability redistribute control-plane power
realization_factors.mechanism: Who maintains definitions, identity and access policies influences the cost and risk of changing engines. Compatible enforcement can preserve Snowflake as the authoritative control plane while allowing external compute. Inconsistent row/column policy behavior or duplicate semantics raises validation and administration costs, favoring a more integrated platform. Customers trade execution flexibility against this ongoing governance burden.
realization_factors.current_status: Horizon’s Scan Plan path is preview with compatibility limits; Fabric requires attention to destination security, and semantic-tool reuse is incomplete. Working inference: existing governance assets provide meaningful switching friction today, while increasingly portable enforcement weakens exclusive engine lock-in.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Policy fidelity and identity compatibility are gates for sensitive work; semantic coverage defines how much can move; duplicated-model administration adds recurring cost. These variables may matter more than a moderate engine price difference for regulated estates. Preview breadth chiefly changes future option value until production use expands. If enforcement becomes equivalent, compute allocation becomes more price/performance-sensitive without requiring a loss of catalog control. No standalone governance monetization or retention premium is assumed; the present leverage is reduced switching friction versus continued integrated trust.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Control-plane and platform-choice economics. AI answer accuracy and core self-service benefit are separate Unit effects; data retention, governance retention and query revenue are explicitly different outcomes.

realization_factors.name: Total platform economics and switching friction allocate customer budgets
realization_factors.mechanism: Enterprises compare effective contract price and bundled capabilities with staff skills, duplicate-tool costs and migration/validation risk. Existing commitments and internal standards favor incumbents; funded migration support and discounts can lower a challenger’s hurdle. Rival financing enables investment or subsidy but does not itself create demand. New projects can be allocated to a challenger before it is rational to move the installed estate.
realization_factors.current_status: Fabric has substantial paying adoption and Databricks has commercial scale and funding. Snowflake also has an expanding large-customer base. The strongest working reading is competition for incremental workloads and renewal leverage, with installed-base inertia; neither rival totals nor funding establish direct losses.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Bundle breadth and effective price act on the whole buyer budget; skill reuse and ongoing operations affect recurring cost; migration risk and unamortized commitments impose one-time hurdles. Subsidy can accelerate a decision, but ongoing task economics determine retention after it expires. New workloads are more contestable this quarter than deeply integrated legacy ones. Current competitor counts and run rates differ in definition, so they show economic substance, not common market shares. A permanent price concession affects all retained units, whereas a migration grant mainly changes timing and acquisition economics; their effects should not be summed as independent demand.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: General data/AI platform allocation and renewal position. Dedicated Postgres and telemetry competitive decisions remain in their Units/Shells; Snowflake vendor margin and sales expense are finance-owned outcomes.

realization_factors.name: Application owners shape the platform contest before engine selection
realization_factors.mechanism: ERP and CRM vendors control data products, business semantics and the application purchasing relationship. They can embed analytics/agents or offer governed sharing to several platforms. Access terms, integration effort and the cost of rebuilding context influence whether the buyer starts with an application-native solution or an independent data platform. Existing Snowflake assets can complement rather than be replaced by these arrangements.
realization_factors.current_status: SAP’s Business Data Cloud includes Databricks technology; Salesforce supports multiple zero-copy routes. This establishes source-owner distribution power, not exclusivity. The current economic reading is stronger competition for application-linked incremental work, alongside complementary cross-system analysis.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Source-data coverage and usable semantics determine which tasks the application can keep close; access terms can gate alternatives; purchasing convenience and integration labor affect near-term allocation. Cross-application complexity works the other way, increasing the usefulness of an independent analytical platform. A bundled application decision can redirect a project before engine benchmarks matter, giving this route potentially broader reach than a point performance improvement. The relevant exposure is source-application-linked work, not all data engineering. No installed-base displacement percentage is established.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns platform selection driven by external application owners. Core Unit owns resulting query/collaboration demand; AI Unit owns task-specific interface and content capture. Application fees are not Snowflake revenue.

realization_factors.name: Local execution substitutes for selected repeated warehouse work
realization_factors.mechanism: An application or developer can materialize a working set and analyze it with a lightweight local/embedded engine. Data size, refresh frequency and network transfer determine feasibility; concurrency and governance determine whether it can replace a managed service. Frequent reuse can amortize the initial extraction, while fast-changing data or multiuser controls favor live warehouse execution. Source preparation may remain on Snowflake even when downstream scans move.
realization_factors.current_status: DuckDB provides a credible multi-source analytical engine route, but capability is not evidence of a wholesale enterprise migration. Working inference: small or reusable working sets are the more exposed class; large, sensitive and highly concurrent workloads face materially stronger barriers.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Working-set size and memory/compute needs bound technical reach; refresh rate and transfer costs govern whether caching saves work; reuse frequency determines payoff. Concurrency and controls can dominate modest compute-price savings. Displacement can occur within a project cycle without a platform-contract cancellation, but light workloads may be small in paid dollars despite numerous users. Agent-generated analysis could increase their aggregate reach over time. The present evidence supports a bounded alternative, not a fleet-wide consumption haircut or a claim that all DuckDB source reads bypass Snowflake.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: General analytical execution substitution. It is distinct from open-table cloud federation and from transactional database selection. Source ingestion and retained data preparation are not assumed to disappear.

potential_gaps.name: Open architectures separate governance retention from compute retention
potential_gaps.why_live: Federation, direct Iceberg reads and Fabric mirroring provide different execution paths. External policy enforcement and semantic compatibility remain uneven, so an open connection is not a uniform migration.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The baseline is hybrid, staged allocation. Changes to routing and governance fidelity can redirect repeated work while retaining data or catalog relationships; initial extraction can have the opposite near-term sign from later query displacement.

possibility_space.name: Customers expand JDBC federation as their primary access route
possibility_space.implication: External interfaces can continue executing queries in Snowflake. More competitor-front-end use would not by itself establish compute loss.

possibility_space.name: Eligible Iceberg workloads move to direct external execution
possibility_space.implication: Repeated scans can leave Snowflake without data relocation. Table eligibility and workload frequency determine the significance, not table count alone.

possibility_space.name: Fabric mirrors become the destination for recurring analytics
possibility_space.implication: Source extraction may support Snowflake consumption during transition, while subsequent analysis increasingly runs elsewhere. A short-term source spike can mask weaker durable allocation.

possibility_space.name: Cross-engine controls reach acceptable production fidelity
possibility_space.implication: Reduced policy and semantic friction makes execution more contestable. Snowflake may retain authoritative governance but not the same compute economics; conversely unresolved controls can keep sensitive work native.

potential_gaps.name: Bundles and application owners change who gets the next workload
potential_gaps.why_live: Fabric and Databricks have commercial adoption, while ERP/CRM vendors control valuable data and purchasing relationships. Existing skills and migration risks still protect incumbent deployments.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The current view favors project-by-project competition rather than immediate wholesale replacement. Changes in total buyer economics or control of business context can shift new-project allocation and renewal leverage before installed data estates move.

possibility_space.name: Enterprise buyers consolidate analytics and AI into an integrated suite
possibility_space.implication: Duplicate tooling and procurement costs decline, making incremental work more likely to go to the chosen suite even while overall data demand grows.

possibility_space.name: ERP or CRM owners package context-rich analytics with their applications
possibility_space.implication: The contest begins at the source application rather than at an engine benchmark. Independent Snowflake work can be displaced or complemented by cross-application analysis, depending on sharing access.

possibility_space.name: Funded rivals subsidize migration or implementation
possibility_space.implication: Lower switching hurdles can pull projects forward. Lasting allocation depends on operating economics after subsidies, so financing itself is not counted as demand.

possibility_space.name: Customers preserve Snowflake where validation and staff reuse dominate
possibility_space.implication: A price or bundle advantage elsewhere may not compensate for migration and control risk. Competition can remain strongest for new projects rather than the core installed estate.

possibility_space.name: Source owners broaden nonexclusive governed access
possibility_space.implication: More data becomes usable across platforms, reducing dependence on one application’s analytical stack. This can strengthen independent data platforms while also increasing execution choices.

potential_gaps.name: Embedded analysis changes the boundary of a cloud warehouse task
potential_gaps.why_live: Lightweight engines offer a feasible route for selected analytical work, while freshness, concurrency, sensitive data and administration constrain substitution. Their existence does not establish a fleet-wide displacement rate.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The working view exposes small or reusable working sets more than managed multiuser estates. A change in application architecture or controls can widen that perimeter without a conventional enterprise-platform migration.

possibility_space.name: Agent builders make local working sets the default analytical scratchpad
possibility_space.implication: Repeated exploration can run outside Snowflake after an initial preparation or export. Core data relationships may persist while recurring scan capture weakens.

possibility_space.name: Applications keep fresh or sensitive analysis on a managed service
possibility_space.implication: Data changes and control requirements can outweigh local savings. Embedded engines then complement the warehouse rather than replace its central workloads.

possibility_space.name: Lightweight deployments gain practical multiuser governance
possibility_space.implication: A presently bounded substitute can become relevant to larger shared workloads, revising the competitive perimeter before customers cancel their main platform contracts.

expectation_baseline.name: Expanded delivery footprint with selective bottlenecks
expectation_baseline.baseline: Working inference: cloud cooperation and wider service coverage support continued migration and AI delivery, but effective availability remains selective by region, model and buyer policy. The five-year AWS commitment supports sustained operating involvement, not a conclusion of unlimited local capacity or a measured discount.
expectation_baseline.ordinary_progress: Additional qualified regional services, Marketplace transactions and implementation projects within existing arrangements.
expectation_baseline.open_frontier: Whether policy, networking or scarce capacity is the binding constraint for particular valuable projects.
expectation_baseline.time_scope: Next several quarters and five-year partnership horizon

realization_factors.name: Effective capacity is the intersection of resources and eligibility
realization_factors.mechanism: Deliverable service capacity is the intersection of physical compute/GPU availability, deployed model/service support, cloud/region coverage, account quotas and customer-permitted processing routes. Providers allocate scarce resources; customers choose their policy perimeter. Spare qualified headroom absorbs demand before expansion is required. Where one intersection is empty, extra capacity elsewhere cannot deliver the project; permissible rerouting can relieve that constraint.
realization_factors.current_status: Broader service coverage and the AWS commitment support continuing delivery, but Snowflake discloses past GPU procurement difficulty. Cross-region controls make local and globally available model capacity economically different. The current model is selective bottlenecks, not an unsupported claim of a company-wide shortage or unlimited capacity.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Physical headroom governs near-term provisioning sensitivity; service/model compatibility determines what resources can serve the task; route permissions and region eligibility are hard access gates. Quotas can throttle demand even when hardware exists. With spare eligible headroom, more activity mainly raises utilization; near the limit, the same demand changes wait times, allocations and expansion needs. The five-year $6 billion commitment indicates a substantial resource relationship but cannot be divided into GPU counts or assumed regional reservations. AWS hosts a majority of customers, so disruption there has broader potential reach than an isolated new-region launch; the affected workloads and actual headroom remain unmeasured.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns effective supply and delivery timing across core and AI. Customer-side legal approval is not inferred from product geography. Procurement unit costs and commitment-utilization profit effects belong to finance.

realization_factors.name: Procurement eligibility and joint selling turn budgets into project starts
realization_factors.mechanism: Cloud commitments and approved procurement routes shape the buyer’s incremental purchasing hurdle. Marketplace eligibility, private offers and seller incentives affect which provider is presented and which deployment qualifies. Co-selling and joint migration support can accelerate approval; the resulting contract still needs implementation and actual use. Broader model-provider commercial channels can likewise make already-committed budgets usable for Snowflake services.
realization_factors.current_status: AWS cooperation includes Marketplace and migration/customer-success investment. AWS distinguishes wholly AWS-deployed SaaS in its Marketplace framework. The useful inference is lower friction for eligible buyers, not guaranteed new demand: an existing direct purchase may simply change its channel.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Eligible committed budgets set accessible purchasing capacity, not consumption demand. Effective buyer price and seller incentives influence selection; legal/procurement friction shifts timing; implementation determines conversion to use. The announced cumulative Marketplace sales above $7 billion demonstrate a meaningful channel but are not annual recurring usage or a near-term pipeline forecast. Where a customer has unused eligible commitments, channel treatment can matter more than a small feature difference; without such commitments, benefits may be administrative only. Joint selling can favor a partner while cloud-native products compete for the same project.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns procurement access and delivery channel. The $6 billion Snowflake-to-AWS purchase commitment is separate from customers’ AWS budgets. Cash settlement and vendor cost are finance-owned; competitive allocation is shared context, not an assumption of exclusive distribution.

realization_factors.name: Implementation capacity and incentives determine production throughput
realization_factors.mechanism: Integrators and customer teams supply coding, migration, data-modeling, security and testing capacity. Repeatable playbooks and AI assistance reduce some work; validation, organizational change and scarce specialist skills can become the new critical path. Partner incentives and alternative platform alliances determine where this labor is allocated. More sold projects increase queues unless throughput expands or work per project falls.
realization_factors.current_status: Snowflake’s ecosystem participates in selling and delivery; other AI platforms also recruit integrators. Management’s faster-migration example supports potential labor savings but does not establish broad project productivity. Working inference: coding automation helps, while customer validation and governance keep implementation from becoming instantaneous.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Qualified staff and allocation set projects deliverable per quarter; labor per project determines effective capacity; testing/approval time governs the critical path; reuse increases scale across subsequent projects. At a binding staffing limit, saved coding work can bring cutovers forward, but it does not help a project blocked by data rights. Partner incentives can change the target platform even with unchanged end demand. Current project counts and utilization are unreported, so the scale assessment is a throughput constraint rather than a numerical conversion of partnership announcements into orders. This route can change timing over quarters and the reachable customer base over years.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns ecosystem delivery capability for core and AI. Core migration and AI adoption retain their own resulting demand consequences. Integrator revenue, Snowflake sales expense and acquisition costs are not modeled as this Unit’s revenue.

realization_factors.name: Connectivity and resilience govern access to sensitive production systems
realization_factors.mechanism: Enterprise network reach, private connectivity, access configuration and regional reliability determine whether a technically available service can reach required data with acceptable continuity. Customer recovery requirements can mandate redundant routes or regions, adding implementation work. An outage can reduce immediate service and strengthen future redundancy demand; better connectivity can release previously isolated workloads.
realization_factors.current_status: The October 15 Lumen announcement is a planned secure-connectivity arrangement, not delivered capacity or signed customer use. Cross-region processing is already policy-dependent. The working model treats network and resilience requirements as an independent delivery gate rather than assuming a model launch makes sensitive data reachable.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Network access is binary for isolated systems; setup effort affects time to deployment; availability and recovery tolerance set the architecture and permitted production scope. Redundant arrangements may increase resources but also reduce disruption sensitivity. A network improvement can have high leverage for a small previously blocked project set and little effect on already connected cloud-native users. Incidents can matter within hours; architecture/approval changes take quarters. No measured outage loss or Lumen-related incremental project value is established, so opportunity release and delivered capacity remain distinct.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns infrastructure reach and continuity. Core identity trust and AI delegated-action authority are separate constraints. Cloud supplier costs and financial outage liabilities remain adjacent subjects.

potential_gaps.name: Qualified supply and resilience change the reachable project set
potential_gaps.why_live: The platform has broad cloud relationships but usable supply is constrained by service/model deployment, customer routing policy and physical headroom. The AWS purchase commitment is not a regional reservation schedule; Lumen connectivity is a plan.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The baseline supports continued delivery with selective bottlenecks. A change in the binding intersection can release projects or delay them even with unchanged end demand; more capacity in an ineligible location has little immediate value.

possibility_space.name: Providers deploy approved models in previously constrained regions
possibility_space.implication: Locally restricted customers gain a usable service path. The addressable delivery footprint expands without requiring a change in their data-residency policy.

possibility_space.name: Regional capacity or service quotas tighten
possibility_space.implication: Ready projects can be delayed or routed differently. Where policy prevents substitution, the effect is lost delivery time rather than simply a different compute price.

possibility_space.name: Customers broaden permissible inference routes
possibility_space.implication: Existing capacity becomes usable without new physical installation; providers with the right model and policy support capture the released work.

possibility_space.name: Private connections open access to isolated enterprise systems
possibility_space.implication: The Lumen-type route can lower a distinct network barrier. Announced infrastructure only changes actual delivery as the required connection becomes usable, but can revise future reachable opportunity earlier.

possibility_space.name: An outage changes recovery and regional-diversification requirements
possibility_space.implication: Customers may delay deployment, add redundancy or choose another region/provider. More redundant resources can coexist with weaker near-term onboarding rather than imply stronger underlying task demand.

potential_gaps.name: Procurement rules and channel incentives redirect eligible budgets
potential_gaps.why_live: AWS cooperation includes Marketplace, migration and customer-success investment. Cloud providers simultaneously operate purchasing channels and competing native services; customer commitments are distinct from Snowflake’s own purchases.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The current view expects lower friction for eligible buyers, not automatic incremental consumption. Eligibility, private offers and seller incentives can change the projects Snowflake can win or their timing before customer activity changes.

possibility_space.name: Marketplace or private-offer treatment makes committed budgets usable
possibility_space.implication: Procurement can accelerate for buyers with qualifying commitments. Some transactions are net new projects, while others merely reroute existing direct purchases.

possibility_space.name: Cloud sellers prioritize native products or narrow partner eligibility
possibility_space.implication: Snowflake can lose access or visibility despite unchanged capabilities. The affected cloud/customer cohort matters more than the total partnership headline.

possibility_space.name: Joint selling is paired with practical migration support
possibility_space.implication: Channel access converts more readily into delivered projects when implementation obstacles also ease. This compounds rather than duplicates the sales benefit; a purchase alone still does not fix usage timing.

potential_gaps.name: Implementation economics move the deployment bottleneck
potential_gaps.why_live: Integrators and customer teams still supply scarce validation, security and modeling work. Coding assistance and repeatable playbooks can reduce delivery effort, while competing alliances influence where partner capacity goes.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The working reference is improved but noninstantaneous implementation. Changes in labor allocation, project standardization or the critical path can alter production throughput with broadly unchanged customer interest and hardware.

possibility_space.name: Integrators standardize end-to-end migration and agent deployment
possibility_space.implication: Reusable conversion, evaluation and approval work can raise effective delivery capacity, bringing more projects into production per quarter.

possibility_space.name: Automation shifts the queue to customer validation or organizational change
possibility_space.implication: Fewer coding hours do not translate into equivalent throughput. The opportunity remains, but delivery and consumption are deferred.

possibility_space.name: Partner incentives and skills migrate to competing platforms
possibility_space.implication: Implementation resources follow another ecosystem, weakening Snowflake’s practical ability to serve projects despite technically adequate cloud resources.

possibility_space.name: Customers take more delivery in-house using agent-assisted tools
possibility_space.implication: Reduced dependence on external staffing can speed routine projects, while complex regulated deployments remain constrained by specialist expertise.

expectation_baseline.name: Integrated transactional foothold, not established mass migration
expectation_baseline.baseline: Working inference: Snowflake Postgres is best positioned initially where existing analytics relationships and fresh transaction data remove a real integration burden. GA and a named operational case support continued deployment, but builder defaults and incumbent database trust make a broad generic-Postgres takeover a weaker starting view.
expectation_baseline.ordinary_progress: More qualified applications and one-way mirrors within supported deployments.
expectation_baseline.open_frontier: Persistent production runtime and incumbent migrations versus mostly experimental databases, and whether integrated operational feedback becomes usable.
expectation_baseline.time_scope: Several quarters to multiyear application decisions

realization_factors.name: Developer defaults allocate new application databases
realization_factors.mechanism: AI coding/no-code builders choose database provisioning, auth/storage APIs and deployment integration on behalf of developers. Low setup friction and ecosystem compatibility can make the backend an invisible default. The number of generated applications creates opportunities, but survival and promotion into production determine persistent workload. Snowflake’s existing enterprise data relationships provide another distribution route; PostgreSQL compatibility reduces rewriting but does not replicate a builder’s entire backend experience.
realization_factors.current_status: Supabase’s platform offering provides automated managed backend provisioning and builder distribution; Lakebase is a real alternative. Snowflake Postgres is commercially available, but no comparable Snowflake builder-distribution or persistent customer count is established. The useful reading is an expanding app opportunity with contested, often preselected capture.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Builder reach determines the new-project funnel; default allocation is the immediate participation variable; provisioning effort and API completeness influence developer choice. Application survival and production conversion dominate durable value, since many generated projects can be dormant. Existing enterprise access may be smaller in database count but larger per production workload. Therefore large public project counts are not comparable with Snowflake customers or paid runtime. Distribution improvements can revise future opportunity before revenue, whereas compatibility alone mainly lowers switching/development effort.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns Snowflake Postgres new-application demand and dedicated database choice. General code-agent inference belongs to the AI Unit; this Factor does not assume every generated app needs Snowflake analytics.

realization_factors.name: Transactional acceptance and operating economics govern incumbent migration
realization_factors.mechanism: An application owner compares service reliability, recovery, extension compatibility, network/security fit and operating effort with its incumbent database. Migration validation, downtime and rollback risk impose a switching hurdle. Once accepted, persistent instance runtime, chosen compute capacity, storage and replication determine consumption; higher request activity may initially use existing headroom rather than require a larger instance. Existing platform commitments can simplify purchase without guaranteeing incremental total spend.
realization_factors.current_status: February GA material positions Snowflake Postgres for enterprise workloads and spend consolidation. Actual application acceptance is not implied by GA or community compatibility. Working inference: existing Snowflake-linked applications have a clearer economic entry point than indiscriminate migration of all incumbent Postgres systems. Standalone revenue and production counts are unreported.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Reliability and required extensions are gates, not marginal feature scores; migration/downtime risk sets timing, often over several quarters. Operating effort and effective price affect enduring choice. Persistent hours and capacity determine the consumption floor, storage accumulates, and replicas add service resources; transaction count matters through utilization until a capacity threshold is crossed. An idle but persistent production instance and a busy short-lived test instance have different economics. At current unmeasured installed scale, deployment acceptance and retained runtime are more informative than generic PostgreSQL popularity. Current cost documentation is used to explain resource categories, not to invent historical rates.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns transactional customer adoption, runtime and unit consumption. Vendor cloud-input costs and gross margins belong to finance; company-wide capacity credits are not treated as new database revenue merely because they are reallocated.

realization_factors.name: Freshness and integration labor connect transactions to analytical value
realization_factors.mechanism: Applications create transaction changes; change capture and apply cadence determine when analytics sees them. Easier integration reduces connector maintenance and the delay between a transaction and a useful pricing, risk or service decision. Customers adopt an integrated database when those benefits exceed migration and mirror-resource costs. A reverse analytics-to-application loop could add operational value, but it separately requires safe writes, ownership and rollback; one-way mirroring is not a shared synchronous transaction store.
realization_factors.current_status: October 15 mirroring GA and SimCorp’s customer statement establish a current one-way route and business use. Same-account/region/cloud constraints limit accessible deployments; some technical preview labels lag the announcement. Working inference: reduced integration burden and fresher decisions are the strongest current differentiated adoption route, not demonstrated generic database superiority.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Transaction-change volume and apply cadence set synchronization work; required freshness and the economic loss from stale decisions determine customer value. Integration labor savings lower the adoption hurdle; migration risk and deployment compatibility restrict reach. Mirror compute/storage can offset avoided third-party work, while new analytics may create additional consumption. A high-value pricing decision may justify a deployment with modest data volume. Reverse-flow authority can expand the future task perimeter but is not credited as current capability. No customer-wide latency, cost saving or revenue coefficient is inferred from one named case.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns Postgres adoption and its integration proposition. Core analytical queries and AI inference remain separate consumption objects; duplicated revenue attribution is avoided. Mirroring commercial status does not establish transaction-database market share.

realization_factors.name: Environment lifecycle separates database creation from paid production
realization_factors.mechanism: Developers and agents create isolated branches or test databases to experiment safely. Provisioning speed, copying method and cleanup policy determine how many environments and how long they remain active. Branch lifetime, capacity and storage changes create consumption independently of application count. Successful tests promote into long-lived production; disposable work can instead end without any recurring database.
realization_factors.current_status: Lakebase documents branching and Supabase automates project provisioning. These provide useful mechanisms and competitive reference points, not proof of equivalent Snowflake features. The working model is a large development funnel with much lower persistent production conversion than raw project counts would imply; the precise conversion is unmeasured.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Provisioning friction and isolation influence platform choice; environment count governs gross breadth, while lifetime and capacity govern resource-hours. Copy/storage behavior and cleanup affect the cost of experimentation; promotion and production retention dominate multiyear value. If a team doubles branches but halves active lifetime, resource-hours need not rise. This illustrative identity is not an observed customer response. Branch-heavy tools can win developers before enterprise procurement begins, making lifecycle convenience important for opportunity allocation even when present revenue is small. Persistent transactional acceptance remains the stronger economic endpoint than a database-count milestone.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns development/test and promotion economics for transactional applications. This is distinct from coding-agent token consumption and from the analytics engine’s data clone behavior; no unsupported Snowflake branching parity is asserted.

realization_factors.name: Durable agent state creates database demand but not automatic Postgres capture
realization_factors.mechanism: Long-running agents need persistent session facts and execution state. State updates, retention and recovery semantics create storage/read/write work; the application chooses whether to use its transactional database, a workflow service or a managed memory product. Semantic memories and reliable execution checkpoints serve different purposes, so one cannot be converted mechanically into the other or into Postgres instances.
realization_factors.current_status: AWS described managed long-term memory in October 2025; Temporal distinguishes execution state from agent memory. These external arrangements establish a feasible alternative to application-owned state, not Snowflake Postgres usage. The working interpretation is a new persistent workload opportunity with unresolved service allocation.
realization_factors.materiality_context: Session persistence and state-update frequency set activity; retention determines stored scale; recovery/idempotency requirements determine acceptable architecture. Service allocation is the decisive Snowflake capture variable. More agents need not mean more relational databases if a managed runtime absorbs state. Conversely, integration with transactional business records could favor a shared database. This is a potentially meaningful future task class, not a measured contribution to current Postgres revenue.
realization_factors.scope_boundary: Owns the potential transactional/state workload and provider choice. AI inference and historical analytical logs remain separate; no native Snowflake memory feature or customer deployment is asserted.

potential_gaps.name: Generated applications become durable databases or disposable experiments
potential_gaps.why_live: Builder provisioning and Lakebase branching make database creation easy, while Snowflake’s own persistent production customer count is unmeasured. Project creation and paid runtime are different quantities.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The current foothold view does not assume a generic Postgres takeover. A shift in default distribution or production conversion can change opportunity scale and capture; changes in branch lifetime can move consumption even at unchanged application count.

possibility_space.name: A major builder embeds Snowflake Postgres as a provisioning option or default
possibility_space.implication: Database choice moves upstream to the builder relationship. This can expand the new-application funnel before enterprise database procurement, without proving enduring paid conversion.

possibility_space.name: Competing backends retain the default through integrated application services
possibility_space.implication: Authentication, storage and deployment convenience can keep new applications elsewhere despite SQL compatibility, limiting Snowflake’s capture of an expanding app market.

possibility_space.name: Successful prototypes move into long-lived production
possibility_space.implication: Persistent capacity and retained applications become a more useful economic base than trial project counts; service reliability and operating cost become increasingly important.

possibility_space.name: Agentic teams proliferate short-lived branches and automate cleanup
possibility_space.implication: More databases can coexist with flat or lower resource-hours. Services optimized for disposable isolation can win development share without proportional production revenue.

potential_gaps.name: Production acceptance opens or blocks incumbent transactional estates
potential_gaps.why_live: Postgres GA establishes an available service, not application-specific acceptance. Existing managed databases retain advantages from operating history, extensions and tested recovery; Snowflake relationships can simplify procurement.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The starting view favors applications already close to Snowflake analytics. Reliability, compatibility and migration economics can expand that foothold into persistent incumbent workloads or leave it concentrated in new experiments.

possibility_space.name: Application owners qualify failover, recovery and required extensions
possibility_space.implication: A larger installed transactional estate becomes addressable, with sustained runtime rather than one-time migration work. Acceptance is economically distinct from a feature announcement.

possibility_space.name: A critical extension, networking constraint or recovery requirement remains unmet
possibility_space.implication: A willing buyer can retain the incumbent service even if analytical integration is attractive. The barrier is a production gate, not necessarily weaker demand for Postgres.

possibility_space.name: Operational performance or an incident changes buyer trust
possibility_space.implication: Successful operation can reduce future migration friction; a reliability failure can delay or reverse deployment. The scope of affected applications determines the consequence, not general PostgreSQL popularity.

possibility_space.name: Consumption consolidates into existing Snowflake commitments
possibility_space.implication: Transactional use can grow while total incremental customer spend is smaller because budgets are reallocated. The Unit’s commercial foothold strengthens without an equal immediate company-level revenue addition.

potential_gaps.name: Fresh transaction data becomes an operational decision loop
potential_gaps.why_live: October mirroring GA and SimCorp’s issuer-hosted case connect fresh credit-spread data with bond pricing. Current integration is one-way and has deployment restrictions; a reverse link remains a future direction.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The baseline favors integration-led adoption. New business decisions enabled by freshness can enlarge transactional demand, while simple middleware replacement mainly saves engineering effort. A safe feedback loop would change the proposition beyond current one-way replication.

possibility_space.name: Freshness enables pricing, risk or service actions previously too stale
possibility_space.implication: The customer gains a new reason to place transaction data near analytics. Valuable operational decisions can support adoption even at modest data volume.

possibility_space.name: Mirroring mostly replaces an existing CDC pipeline
possibility_space.implication: Support burden falls, but new application or analytical demand may be limited. Genuine customer value need not imply a large net consumption increase.

possibility_space.name: Supported deployments broaden beyond current account or regional boundaries
possibility_space.implication: Previously incompatible estates become reachable, expanding the integration opportunity without changing the underlying business task.

possibility_space.name: Analytics and agent outputs can safely update operational Postgres
possibility_space.implication: Authorized writes, ownership and rollback create a closed decision loop. This could deepen application dependence, but cannot be inferred from one-way GA or treated as synchronous shared storage.

potential_gaps.name: Durable agent state becomes a new database allocation decision
potential_gaps.why_live: Persistent-memory and durable-execution services already offer alternatives to application-managed state. The existing app-generation model does not fully describe where a continuously operating agent keeps recoverable state.
potential_gaps.revision_logic: The Postgres foothold could expand through a new class of persistent application work, or miss it if runtimes abstract the state service away. The revision concerns allocation and persistence, not merely more generated applications or longer prompts.

possibility_space.name: Application teams keep agent state beside transactional business records
possibility_space.implication: Persistent read/write activity can create a new database use case and strengthen integrated application adoption. Snowflake participation depends on suitability and provider selection, not on agent count alone.

possibility_space.name: Cloud or workflow services absorb memory and execution state
possibility_space.implication: Agents can become more persistent without creating separately purchased Snowflake Postgres workloads. The beneficiary is the managed runtime/state service.

possibility_space.name: Teams separate recoverable workflow state from semantic memory
possibility_space.implication: Several services may share the workload: a database holds business transactions while a workflow engine handles recovery and another store holds memory. The addressable Postgres portion is narrower than total agent state activity.

shells.scope: 以Observe及Snowflake遥测业务为中心的企业可观测性市场，覆盖SRE与运维客户、日志指标追踪和agent监控、遥测管道与存储、查询及故障处置、产品商业化、采购预算与既有监控平台竞争。共同背景包括OpenTelemetry、事件表、开放存储与查询路径，以及独立部署和Snowflake平台连接。

expectation_baseline.name: 近期规模以有限并表贡献与逐步客户扩展为参照
expectation_baseline.baseline: 工作基线采用管理层09-02重申的Observe贡献约1个百分点FY2027产品收入增长，而不是把公司整体增长上调归给Observe。既有产品、采购入口和历史生产规模支持它继续经营并逐步扩展，不支持把整个Snowflake客户群视作已转换客户。这是公司预期与经营证据综合，不是市场已定价结论。
expectation_baseline.ordinary_progress: 存量使用延续、更多部门或客户进入部署、年度贡献按原有假设兑现。
expectation_baseline.open_frontier: 新增运维预算迁入、持续扩额的速度，以及独立收入和留存相对这一本来有限的近期规模是否明显改变。

expectation_baseline.name: 开放路线先共存再争夺主工作流
expectation_baseline.baseline: 开放采集和存储会继续降低并行评估门槛，但默认路径是部分数据或查询共存，而非一次性整套替换。Observe on Iceberg仍为受限预览，Datadog等已有兼容路径和大客户基础；数据留在开放湖不保证Observe获得查询。
expectation_baseline.ordinary_progress: 试点、限定范围的外部读取和现有告警保持运行；预览范围内的兼容改善。
expectation_baseline.open_frontier: 生产资格与区域扩展的时间，以及客户最终把哪些告警、查询和事故处置迁入Observe。
expectation_baseline.time_scope: 未来数季至多年度架构周期

expectation_baseline.name: agent监控先从早期部署学习而非形成普遍收入
expectation_baseline.baseline: agent任务增加使质量、成本和完整轨迹成为合理采购对象；但Observe该产品仍处于即将私有预览的计划阶段，近期默认是评估与迭代。已有AI SRE排障产品的使用不能当作新agent质量产品已生产商业化。
expectation_baseline.ordinary_progress: 按计划展示、有限客户评估、SDK和评估流程改进。
expectation_baseline.open_frontier: 愿为持续生产评估付费的任务范围、买方与Observe获配，而不只是获得更多SDK账户。
expectation_baseline.time_scope: 接下来产品周期及未来数季

expectation_baseline.name: 遥测增长在优化与合同结构中转化
expectation_baseline.baseline: 未来更多遥测仍将伴随过滤、采样与预算控制；默认不把原始数据、查询或agent调用与收入作一比一外推。已有ingest包含compute的商业方案，使查询增强先体现为使用价值和资源负载，收入扩张更依赖导入承诺、客户获配及续约；其他合同需按自身条款解释。
expectation_baseline.ordinary_progress: 保留关键数据、删减低价值重复信号，围绕既有采购方案扩大覆盖或降低浪费。
expectation_baseline.open_frontier: 优化节省是被重新投入还是直接压低承诺；合同组合和有效价格改变后，更多机器调查是否形成新增收费。
expectation_baseline.time_scope: 季度合同消费及年度续约周期

expectation_baseline.name: 调查自动化与数据后端可分离
expectation_baseline.baseline: 默认是Observe内建AI SRE与外部agent并存。外部供给已GA、Observe也开放程序化上下文，机器可扩大调查覆盖；但是否调用Observe由数据、语义、权限与成本决定，不预设其会成为所有运维agent的必经后端。
expectation_baseline.ordinary_progress: API功能扩展、客户在既有监控上试用自动调查，保留人工审批与关键告警。
expectation_baseline.open_frontier: 入口控制权与后端收费价值是否分离，以及自动化减少每次调查所需查询后对总用量的净效应。
expectation_baseline.time_scope: 未来数季至年度运维工具选择

realization_factors.name: 业务可靠性损失与工程资源决定监控预算
realization_factors.mechanism: 客户业务交易、用户体验及服务依赖决定故障的经济损失；发布与系统复杂度改变调查频率和跨团队协调负担。SRE及工程负责人把可避免的停机和工程工时，与监控费用及实施维护成本比较，在预算负责人批准后采购或扩展。若应用投资减少、服务退出或工具收益不足，产生的数据即使还多，新增付费需求也会缩小。
realization_factors.current_status: 现有日志、APM与基础设施监控仍是Observe经营主体；上游既有客户基础和竞争者扩张说明这是现实采购而非等待agent出现的新市场。厂商将调查而非仅告警定位为效率来源；可用工作假设是可靠性与工程节省共同支撑预算，不能把客户云支出总增速直接套成Observe增长。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 业务关键性决定支付意愿上限：同样故障分钟，对收入关键服务比内部低优先级任务有更大预算影响。服务/发布数量主要扩大监控覆盖与事故机会，复杂度主要增加单次调查的人力；二者不是相同数量驱动。工程资源稀缺会提高自动化收益，而预算审批及实施维护开销决定何时能付费。固定预算时，更多活动首先推动优化与工具重配，不必当季增支。当前成熟监控工作流比待预览的agent产品更接近实际预算，因此续用价值和替换成本对近季更直接；长期应用广度与故障损失才决定可服务机会。没有客户损失率和工时总量，不能给全体客户构造美元TAM。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 覆盖本Unit的基础SRE、运维和应用开发需求；企业一般AI/数据投资由邻域深究，但其对可靠性需求的传导在此保留。

realization_factors.name: 生产agent把质量和成本归因变成持续监控任务
realization_factors.mechanism: 业务负责人只有在agent完成的任务有足够价值且风险可控时才扩大生产采用。生产任务频次、每任务的模型/工具步骤与重试、跨系统链路，形成轨迹数量和上下文大小；错误答案即使没有系统报错也需要评估。可测质量、业务结果联结和成本归属，使AI工程、风险或业务预算支付监控；框架自带记录或专用评估工具也能承接部分任务，不必落到Observe。
realization_factors.current_status: Observe已提出会话追踪、在线评估与业务数据关联方案，但截止日前仍是待私有预览的计划。外部标准建设使跨模型采集有可行基础，且客户可保持偏好的离线评估工具。当前解释是需求空间正在扩展、供给与预算分配仍早期；Snowflake AI周使用账户只说明相邻平台采用，不是Observe付费用户。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 生产任务是否保留并扩大，决定整条链的机会广度，影响高于每条span的技术尺寸；不能把试用次数与生产持续性同权。步骤、重试及上下文长度提高每任务资源强度，模型路由和成功率改善可反向减少浪费。评估覆盖比例决定检查工作量，业务后果与评估可信性决定客户愿付多少，专用工具和框架的分工决定Observe获配。新任务尚可在商用前改变长期机会判断，但当前交付阶段限制近季付费贡献。若质量检测不能改善任务结果，更多日志只增加成本；若改善可使原本不敢上线的任务进入生产，机会扩大可以超过单任务节省。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 拥有agent遥测和评估采购后果；agent本身的任务需求和模型平台竞争与企业AI邻域连接，不将其全部收入归入Observe。

realization_factors.name: 遥测密度与选择性保留共同决定可收费工作量
realization_factors.mechanism: 应用活动和仪表化覆盖生成原始日志、指标与追踪；客户或管道运营者通过过滤、采样、聚合和基数管理选择实际导入。导入率与保留窗口形成存量，压缩影响物理存储，查询频次、扫描范围及加速配置形成处理工作量。Observe可低成本保留高保真数据，也必须与有效删减低价值数据的方案比较；成本下降可刺激覆盖和保留的反弹，不能只取降本或增长的一边。
realization_factors.current_status: 历史生产规模已证明Observe处理的不是空白市场，但2025年日导入、扫描和查询是不同口径且不是2026年读数。Datadog有送入前采样路径，Grafana已将自动优化覆盖到四类信号。当前边际压力更像客户选择哪些数据值得保留，而非无条件把全部生成数据送到同一后端。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 原始活动扩大机会底盘，采集密度决定每单位活动数据；采样/过滤是导入量的直接杠杆。以恒定模式作敏感度示例，原始数据增加50%且保留比例从100%降至50%，导入量为原先75%，不是增长50%；这是算术情景而非预测。保留期主要改存量，压缩主要改物理资源，都不等于同幅改变按未压缩导入收费的收入。查询次数与扫描范围共同定工作量，一次窄查与全湖扫描不能同计价值。竞品已报告大幅trace减量，说明优化幅度可超过普通活动增量；但低成本也可释放原先被舍弃的覆盖。近季合同缓冲会延后价格反应，跨年度承诺和覆盖调整才决定净结果。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 解释遥测数据到业务使用的物理链；收费映射另由合同因子解释。存储与云成本对公司利润的最终影响归财务邻域。

realization_factors.name: 采购通道、替换摩擦与竞争组合分配运维预算
realization_factors.mechanism: Snowflake额度、销售触达和统一采购减少Observe试点的审批工作；但SRE选择仍取决于可替代功能、告警和值班集成、迁移培训、并行运行成本，以及既有供应商续约组合与折扣。客户可先迁日志后迁关键事故流程。独立运维预算流入、原有Snowflake额度转用和总额度新增是三个不同的经济结果。
realization_factors.current_status: credits入口已开放，Datadog则有增长的大客户基础及AI、客户云部署能力，既有供应商会响应而非静止。当前工作判断是采购便利有利于进入评估，主工作流获配仍比完成付款更难；既有credits使用可提高Observe业务活动，但对Snowflake净新增消费可能部分抵销。 外部采购背景还包括Palo Alto Networks已收购Chronosphere并保留独立遥测管道供给；其自动化整合属于公告计划，不能当作已完成的统一产品。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 销售触达扩大可接触客户，审批便利主要缩短启动时间；两者不能代替技术与操作切换。功能覆盖和事故风险决定可替换预算比例，培训/双运行决定迁移速度与首年净收益，竞品折扣改变节省的可达幅度。Datadog大客户数由约3,850增至4,720说明争取的是已有成熟采购基础，不是可相加的Observe潜客数。当前对近季最敏感的是获配深度和持续扩额，不是注册量；已有闲置credits时，采购变易可能只重分配总消费，续约买更多额度才扩大公司需求。管理层全年约1个百分点增长贡献限制了将交叉销售立即解释为公司主要增长源的合理性，但不限制长期运维预算迁入的机会。 安全平台拥有运维产品后，联合采购可把议价和数据路由控制上移到安全负责人；影响的是谁决定预算分配，不以Observe具备完整SIEM能力为前提。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 拥有Observe获客、留存、替换及交叉采用；合同现金结算、收购投入与公司利润率归财务邻域，不在这里重复计收益。

realization_factors.name: 开放采集与客户数据湖把接入和计算获配拆开
realization_factors.mechanism: OTel降低采集端绑定，独立管道让客户控制过滤、路由与双写；Iceberg及客户存储把数据保管与分析后端分离。Observe可以因低锁定顾虑而进入客户架构，也可能只负责导入/上下文，反复查询由外部引擎承担。实际分工受表管理、目录权限、读写支持、区域与生产资格制约；采集兼容不自动迁移告警和值班语义。
realization_factors.current_status: Observe on Iceberg仍是受限私有预览，不能推为任意自管表和多云生产服务。外部只读访问在支持范围内已有清楚路径；Cribl提供管道/湖替代，AWS特定S3访问日志也有CloudWatch加开放表的原生路径。因此现阶段共存与部分获配比全栈独占更符合供给形态。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 采集标准主要减少接入与试点工程量；管道路由可直接重分配后端数据份额，影响在无需搬动应用时即可发生。数据所有权降低退出顾虑、扩大可服务客户，但目录/表支持限定真正可接入的那部分；区域及生产资格对受限客户是能否采用的离散约束，比小幅查询效率提升更重要。引擎选择决定重复分析的长期获配，即使存储不迁也可能失去计算；反之开放读取不代表告警工作流流失。当前Observe部署范围约束其近期扩张，未来若放宽会先扩大合资格市场，再由工作流和成本分配份额。AWS例子只覆盖指定日志源，不能将所有云日志总量视作既成替代。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 同时解释开放路线的新增入口与分流；Observe产品支持范围属于本Unit，一般平台Iceberg竞争由邻域深究。

realization_factors.name: 数据完整性与实时可靠性决定从旁路分析到主事故工作台
realization_factors.mechanism: Observe把采集来的信号经元数据、资源关系与上下文关联，支持搜索、告警和调查。若导入跟不上突发流量、关联缺失、查询延迟过长或告警不可信，客户即使认可低成本也会保留旧平台处理关键事故。正确配置、持续交付和可依赖的运维表现改善，才能增加主工作台使用及续用深度。
realization_factors.current_status: 10月14日发布记录显示APM分类、告警、AI SRE与吞吐修复仍在推进，且fast/slow lane交付分开。OTel自备collector文档给出自2026-07-01起新租户RED预计算默认配置的适配要求；否则Service Explorer可显示零请求。这是有解的集成差异，不是所有客户失效或已发生大面积事故。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 导入吞吐和高峰余量决定数据是否在最需要时可用；资源关联和元数据准确性决定能否找到根因，低延迟决定工程师是否在事故现场持续用它，告警可信性决定是否敢撤旧系统。四者均可在原始需求不变时改变留存和预算深度；平均吞吐足够时，峰值可靠性与语义正确性比继续提高日总容量更有边际价值。正确配置与客户工程投入影响上线速度；分批推广延长统一能力到达时间，却也可降低一次升级风险。当前有运行产品与具体修复而无全体客户故障率、延迟分位数据，故将主工作台扩展看作逐步迁移，不给未量化可靠性虚构分数。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 拥有本Unit产品交付、监控质量与客户工作流；不把软件版本更新本身视作收入，亦不重估公司云采购成本。

realization_factors.name: 调查自动化改变工作量，也重分配入口与上下文价值
realization_factors.mechanism: 内建或外部AI SRE将问题分解、调用遥测并生成根因建议；上下文质量、工具权限、推理准确性和人工审批决定一次调查能自动完成多少。更低每次调查时间可扩大调查覆盖和长尾用户，同时更窄搜索与更少失败调用会降低每次查询工作量。第三方agent掌握入口时，Observe能否仍被调用取决于其独有数据/语义价值和接口成本，而不取决于前端品牌。
realization_factors.current_status: Observe已有AI SRE及MCP路线，CLI在05-05材料仍为计划；外部AWS产品已GA且连接多个监控工具，不能假设天然接入Observe。厂商AI SRE加速样本支持减少调查劳动的可行性，但样本单位为交互，不是所有事故的MTTR，也不证明机器查询必然增长。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 上下文和准确性首先影响完成率与工程价值，权限和人工批准限制能省掉的环节；仅加快检索不等于自动修复。示例上，调查120分钟若降到30分钟，但另有25分钟检测/修复不变，整段由145变55分钟，而非整体四倍；这是条件算例，不是客户实测。调查覆盖人数/事件数决定总调用的外延，每次调查的重试与扫描量决定强度，两者可能反向。入口所有权影响续约谈判与后端分配，接口可用和调用成本决定能否兑现这种分配。当前供应商已有可用服务，入口竞争能先改变未来参与机会；Observe的具体获配比外部agent总数量更有解释力。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 区别监控agent和用于监控的agent；涵盖内外部调查工作流及后端获配，通用编码助手和模型供给不另在此建市场模型。

realization_factors.name: 合同收费基准决定使用价值何时变成业务收入
realization_factors.mechanism: 相同导入和查询活动在不同合同下有不同收入弹性。ingest包含compute的方案以导入承诺、遥测类型、续约扩容和有效价格为主要收费桥；额外调查不必即时多收费。OCC用量模式则更直接联系处理信用消耗。对客户降低每次查询成本能提升使用价值和留存，但不能把底层Snowflake计算、Observe收费和公司合并收入当作三份增量。
realization_factors.current_status: 2025-09-24官方材料已说明ingest及compute包含的方案；文档也保留Ingest和Usage两类许可证的管理工具，后者为当前无精确版本日的辅助线索，不用于倒算截止日合同占比。公开材料不足以建立Observe有效价格、分合同收入和续约桥；因此用分合同工作模型，而不指定全部客户都按查询收费。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 收费单位决定边际使用到收入的斜率，是模型结构而非小参数；价格及折扣决定同一获配的变现，客户承诺/扩容决定量的兑现时间。若合同额度未用尽，新增查询可能主要增加负载与客户价值，收入当季不变；若承诺扩大或按用量结算，影响会更直接。作为条件敏感度，收费量增20%而有效单价降10%，匹配口径收入仅增8%，不是20%。客户/工作流份额扩大是量的独立来源，不能被更低单位资源消耗掩盖。当前管理层约1个百分点全年贡献可定位近期规模，但没有证据把合同结构变化算成具体金额；产品成本和利润影响转交财务域。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 覆盖本Unit商业化与合同消费，不接管现金回收、公司毛利或资金用途；本因子是既有使用/采购方向的中间层解释，不另宣称发生了全客户合同迁移。

realization_factors.name: 遥测与业务数据联结扩展买方，也增加通用引擎替代
realization_factors.mechanism: 可靠性事件需要解释客户、交易和业务后果时，数据负责人和业务团队会增加联结、保留及跨部门查询。共同标识、业务语义与授权使遥测成为可复用数据资产；Observe上下文可节省建模工作，但客户也能在开放湖或已有分析平台完成联结，只购买部分Observe工作流。
realization_factors.current_status: 05-05材料报告数据负责人参与兴趣；09-29官方文章进一步说明业务影响分析，但其金融机构故事明确是hypothetical，不能升级为真实客户采购。当前最合适解释是扩展价值主张已清晰、独立跨部门付费规模仍未形成公开可比基数。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 业务决策用途决定新增预算的上限，标识/语义匹配决定能否联结，授权决定哪些部门可使用；这些条件缺一个，更多遥测本身也不能创造相同价值。复用可减少重复管道和增加历史保留需求，跨部门使用可使单一SRE团队以外的查询扩大；但若通用引擎已能低成本完成任务，新增价值主要落在客户而非Observe收入。当前相对于核心运维续用，这条路线更影响未来买方范围与保留价值，不能用公司全部分析支出估算近季贡献。开放引擎替代与Observe语义节省的比较决定价值捕获，而非数据是否物理存在。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 只拥有遥测资产带来的业务用途和买方后果；企业一般数据建模与分析平台商业化由邻域深入。

realization_factors.name: 内容治理约束高保真轨迹的效用与可服务部署
realization_factors.mechanism: prompt、响应、检索和工具参数越完整，质量归因和事故重建通常越有用，也越可能包含敏感内容。客户安全与数据负责人决定采集授权、脱敏、访问隔离、保留和存储位置。合适控制可解锁原先不能上线的监控；过度删除或不可访问内容则削弱诊断与评估，客户可能改用元数据监控或本地/自有存储。
realization_factors.current_status: Observe拟提供内容丰富的agent轨迹，开放存储预览提供客户S3控制但范围有限。CNCF在03-23的agent工程原则强调数据最小化与治理；它不是针对Observe的法律命令。当前把治理作为企业部署的实质条件，而非认定已发生限制或平台事故。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 采集许可对敏感场景有开/关式影响，存储位置及区域限定可服务客户集合；权限粒度影响可使用团队和审计信任，保留期影响可追溯窗口与存量，脱敏强度影响单条轨迹的分析价值。相较普遍小幅压缩改善，这些变量对受限客户能否进入生产更重要；对已获授权客户，则查询准确性和费用更直接。完整内容不是所有任务的必要条件：只做延迟/成本归属可用较少内容，质量重建更依赖细节。由此同一治理收紧可能缩小高价值内容分析、却保留基础监控。客户持有bucket只解决一部分控制问题，不自动解决跨引擎授权、数据处理或合规资格。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 覆盖本Unit采集、保留、访问与部署后果；不提供特定法律适用结论，不将安全邻接需求扩张等同Observe已有SIEM能力。

potential_gaps.name: 生产agent的任务范围与质量监控预算重新划界
potential_gaps.why_live: 当前基线是需求可扩展、Observe供给仍待私有预览。多步骤agent的错误答案、重试和成本归属不同于传统服务是否报错；框架及专用评估产品也可承接部分工作。10月22日是信息窗口而非预设商用成功。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 可修订的是可服务任务与持续付费深度，不是只调整span增速。客户把什么业务交给agent、是否需要跨系统重建，以及谁控制评估预算，可以在Observe收入出现前改变机会范围；不能把Snowflake的AI活跃账户直接当成Observe采用。

possibility_space.name: 大型企业把agent从辅助问答扩至执行关键业务
possibility_space.implication: 业务后果提高质量归因、跨工具轨迹和审计价值，监控可从试用费用转为持续运营预算。受益取决于Observe能否解释完整业务链，不要求所有任务都在Snowflake运行。

possibility_space.name: 应用或模型平台把基础评估作为默认权益
possibility_space.implication: 监控总覆盖可以增加，但独立工具的基础追踪付费空间收窄。Observe更依赖跨平台上下文、较长保留或业务归因差异，不能以使用者数量判断其变现。

possibility_space.name: 客户暂停低回报或高风险agent项目
possibility_space.implication: 被取消的生产任务减少持续遥测需求；剩余关键任务可能反而提高单任务监控强度。机会的广度与每任务价值发生分化，而非简单全行业同向变化。

possibility_space.name: AI工程团队保留专用离线评估并采用统一生产监控
possibility_space.implication: Observe可获得生产排障和运行质量预算而不替代完整开发工具链；实验次数与生产监控消费的关系减弱，兼容而非独占成为获配路径。

potential_gaps.name: 运维入口外移后Observe的上下文与查询角色
potential_gaps.why_live: AWS等外部AI SRE已可跨监控工具工作，Observe也有内建AI SRE及程序化接口路线。当前基线是并存，外部服务并不天然接入Observe，CLI计划也不等于已交付。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 需要改变的判断是Observe以主工作台、可调用上下文后端还是低差异数据源获益。入口被第三方掌握不必意味着后端流失；自动调查覆盖扩大与每次调查更高效率也可能同时出现。

possibility_space.name: 企业在云支持或编码助手中默认发起事故调查
possibility_space.implication: 人工UI使用减少，后端调用与独特上下文价值更重要。Observe可在没有占据入口时保留业务，但续约谈判更多由外部平台和客户控制。

possibility_space.name: 第三方agent优先调用Observe关系图与监控接口
possibility_space.implication: Observe的角色可从人用工具扩成机器依赖的上下文服务，增加嵌入深度。计费仍取决于合同，不能把每次工具调用各算一份新增收入。

possibility_space.name: 外部agent改为直接查询开放湖和现有日志后端
possibility_space.implication: 原始遥测仍需保存，但Observe的语义及查询层可能被旁路。影响的是参与份额和差异化，而非整个可观测性需求消失。

possibility_space.name: 自动调查减少重复扫描并覆盖以往无人调查的长尾
possibility_space.implication: 效率降低单次工作量，覆盖扩大增加事件数；若原有大量调查是无效查询，净用量可下降而客户价值提高，不能由调查加速幅度反推收入增长。

potential_gaps.name: 数据删减与高保真保留改变遥测增长的经济含义
potential_gaps.why_live: 既有模型已分开原始数据、实际导入、保留存量和扫描。竞品自动优化供给及Observe自身过滤能力，使客户有现实的成本控制选择；agent长链又提高缺失上下文的代价。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 相对“增长伴随常规优化”的基线，修订取决于企业是否改变保留政策，以及节省的资源被削减预算还是重新投入。物理压缩、送入前采样与更少查询是不同路线，不能合并为一个收入下降系数。

possibility_space.name: FinOps与管道团队统一删除低价值重复遥测
possibility_space.implication: 即使应用与agent活动继续增长，后端导入承诺也可能收缩。Observe需争取留下来的高价值数据或扩大客户份额，低单位成本本身不能抵销上游数量减少。

possibility_space.name: 客户把优化节省投入更广覆盖和更长保留
possibility_space.implication: 单位活动资源减少但可监控服务和历史窗口扩大；净机会可能增加，并从短期搜索转向长期分析。更长保留首先增加存量，不一定等比例增加按导入收费的收入。

possibility_space.name: 重大排障暴露采样缺口，客户恢复关键链路完整记录
possibility_space.implication: 高价值、低频失败推动客户保留更完整会话和迟到span，低成本高保真架构的重要性上升。变化可能只限关键服务，不能将其外推为全部健康流量恢复全量采集。

potential_gaps.name: 交叉销售是预算迁入还是原有额度内部重配
potential_gaps.why_live: Snowflake credits已可用于Observe，管理层近期尺度仍是FY2027产品收入增长约1个百分点贡献。成熟监控厂商已有客户关系及组合响应能力；付款入口不等于主工作流替换。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 应修订的是持续获客与净增量理解，而非把所有Observe采用都算成Snowflake新增消费。迁移摩擦、既有承诺和销售组织选择能在行业需求不变时改变扩展路径。

possibility_space.name: 客户把第三方监控预算迁入并扩大Snowflake后续承诺
possibility_space.implication: Observe从便捷采购入口变成独立运维预算来源，交叉销售长期空间高于单纯消耗闲置额度；对公司总需求的意义与内部转用不同。

possibility_space.name: 客户仅将闲置credits用于旁路日志或短期评估
possibility_space.implication: Observe活动可以增长，但主事故平台和公司总承诺未必改变。应收窄对净新增预算的解释，而不是把试点价值视作零。

possibility_space.name: 既有监控厂商以折扣、保留期或附加AI功能防守续约
possibility_space.implication: 客户可能继续双平台或把Observe限定于高量低价数据。采购便利仍在，但可替换预算和有效价格受压，不能只比较公开每GB起价。

possibility_space.name: Snowflake改变独立销售与平台交叉销售的资源配置
possibility_space.implication: 加强SRE专门销售可扩大平台外客户，过度依赖数据平台买方则可能错过独立运维采购。两种配置分别改变触达范围与实施效率，不需先假定总市场预算增长。

potential_gaps.name: 开放遥测架构中的服务资格与工作负载获配
potential_gaps.why_live: OTel、独立管道和开放表允许数据与查询分离；Observe on Iceberg仍有预览、S3、单区域和目录只读边界。云原生日志与开放表路线为替代分工提供现成基础，但不代表覆盖全部遥测。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 当前“先共存、后争主工作流”可因可交付市场扩大、客户所有权安排或查询路由变化而修订。部署资格决定能服务谁，外部引擎选择决定从同一批数据获得什么，两种影响需分别保留。

possibility_space.name: Observe把受限开放存储扩为更广的生产部署
possibility_space.implication: 原先因区域、云或生产资格不能采用的客户进入可服务集合，机会可先于具体收入扩大。真正获配仍由查询与工作流决定，核心Snowflake Iceberg更新不能替代这项产品变化。

possibility_space.name: 企业建立自有统一遥测湖并逐项选择分析后端
possibility_space.implication: Observe可作为其中的采集、语义或事故工具参与，不必获得全部计算。标准化降低试点成本，也降低退出部分后端的成本，数据存在不能作为独占份额证明。

possibility_space.name: 云平台将更多原生日志直接开放给自有分析与运维agent
possibility_space.implication: 客户省去复制及第三方转发，部分任务被云原生路线承接。Observe的机会转向跨云、跨源和上下文差异，不能从特定S3日志路径推成所有日志都已被替代。

possibility_space.name: 目录权限、表管理或跨区域限制让客户保留托管旧方案
possibility_space.implication: 需求并未消失，但开放架构的推进晚于预期，Observe可服务项目和迁移时间收窄；这与客户已采用开放湖却改用其他查询引擎的份额流失不同。

potential_gaps.name: Observe能否承接关键事故而不只低成本数据分析
potential_gaps.why_live: 现有产品已运行且持续修复吞吐、APM、告警与AI SRE；不同租户分批获得能力。低价和采集兼容不能保证关键事故中数据完整、查询及时、告警可信。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 相对逐步共存的基线，产品本身的可靠性、语义与流程便利可独立改变使用深度。变化的经济意义在于客户敢把哪类事故交给Observe，而非版本发布数量。

possibility_space.name: 工程团队把值班、告警与根因调查合并到Observe
possibility_space.implication: 主工作台关系提高续用与部门扩展价值，甚至在原始数据增长不快时也可迁入更多预算。人工与自动调查都可能受益，不必先替换全部历史日志工具。

possibility_space.name: 流量高峰或重大事故中出现持续漏数、误报或查询延迟
possibility_space.implication: 客户可能把关键任务留回旧平台，即使日常低成本分析仍继续；影响集中在高价值工作流和信任，不能以平均日导入容量掩盖。这里是未来可能性，不是已发生事故断言。

possibility_space.name: 产品改善主要惠及日志侧，APM和组织迁移仍分散
possibility_space.implication: Observe可稳定成为高量旁路平台，但全栈替换和预算深度低于主工作台路径。业务有真实价值，只是客户关系与收入结构不同。

potential_gaps.name: 收费与打包方式重塑使用到收入的映射
potential_gaps.why_live: 模型已确认ingest包含compute的方案，同时保留不同许可证可能并存的边界。当前没有有效价格、合同组合和续约桥，不能假定所有查询按OCC单独收费。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 既有工作解释以分合同变现为参照。供应商或买方改变计价单位、承诺与平台权益，会使同样的导入及机器调查具有不同收入弹性；这是商业关系变化，不只是活动量变大或变小。

possibility_space.name: 更多合同转成导入承诺且包含弹性查询
possibility_space.implication: 大量新增调查可能先增加客户价值和交付负载，收入主要随导入承诺、客户获配和续约变化。应降低以查询次数直接外推业务增长的权重。

possibility_space.name: 供应商把高级调查、评估或上下文能力另行商业化
possibility_space.implication: 更有价值的任务可形成数据量之外的付费路径，收入与原始字节关系减弱；若客户认为功能本应包含，另收费也可能损害采用，关键是差异价值与替代供给。

possibility_space.name: 客户要求更大容量承诺折扣或平台权益抵扣
possibility_space.implication: 量和覆盖增长可与有效价格下降并存；Observe业务规模、客户节省及Snowflake总消费并非同一个增量，需按获配及收费边界理解。

potential_gaps.name: 遥测成为企业数据资产后的价值捕获边界
potential_gaps.why_live: 数据负责人参与兴趣已被厂商描述，遥测与业务数据联结的路径清楚；09-29文章的金融故事是明确假设例示，不能当作真实付费部署。开放格式同时让通用分析引擎参与。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 相对以SRE为核心的现状，跨部门任务可扩大保留和分析价值，但增加数据用途不等于增加Observe收费。修订取决于客户需要Observe语义及工作流，还是只需要开放数据。

possibility_space.name: 业务与支持团队反复使用遥测分析客户和交易影响
possibility_space.implication: 新增买方与历史分析窗口扩大可服务任务；即使不再发生同样事故，遥测仍有持续价值。共同标识、语义和授权决定能否复用。

possibility_space.name: 数据团队直接在现有湖仓或BI中完成影响分析
possibility_space.implication: 企业数据价值提高而Observe只保留基础导入或排障份额；应把客户收益与Observe捕获分开，不能将所有跨部门查询都算到本业务。

possibility_space.name: Observe提供可复用业务上下文和交付模板
possibility_space.implication: 减少客户自行建模的工作，可使原本不值得实施的跨部门场景出现；若只是一次性搭建而无持续任务，机会更多体现在实施便利而非长期消费强度。

potential_gaps.name: 敏感内容控制与追溯要求改变高保真监控边界
potential_gaps.why_live: 内容丰富的agent轨迹同时有调试价值和敏感性；客户bucket只解决部分控制问题。现有工程原则强调数据最小化，未建立针对Observe的特定法律限制或平台事故。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 当前治理是部署条件，不是统一利好或利空。未来企业决定收集什么、保存多久及谁能读取，可改变可服务客户范围、每条轨迹价值及部署位置；基础成本监控与完整质量重建可能分离。

possibility_space.name: 大型客户在行业泄露事件后禁止上传原始prompt和工具参数
possibility_space.implication: 质量重建与跨系统归因的内容范围收窄，元数据监控仍可继续；影响更多落在高价值分析能力，不一定等比例减少所有遥测。此处不认定已发生Observe泄露。

possibility_space.name: 客户批准脱敏、细粒度授权与自有存储的受控部署
possibility_space.implication: 原先无法上线的敏感场景进入可服务范围，治理能力成为采用差异。但跨引擎权限和区域资格仍各有边界，自有bucket不等于全面合规。

possibility_space.name: 内审部门要求对关键agent操作保留可重建的长期记录
possibility_space.implication: 关键流程的完整轨迹和保留价值提高，可能支持更高保真监控；通常只覆盖指定任务，且访问与删除规则会改变可交付方案，不将其描述为现行普遍法定义务。

possibility_space.name: 企业将内容分析留在本地，只向中心平台发送摘要与指标
possibility_space.implication: 可保留跨系统健康及成本监控，却减少中心后端的原始内容、存量与调查深度。Observe可能转为部分上下文服务，不能把任务增长原样换算成数据增长。

potential_gaps.name: 安全与运维融合改变共享遥测的采购控制权
potential_gaps.why_live: 原发现只建立共享日志邻接关系，尚不足以扩张Observe的完整安全市场。补充的01-29官方披露确认Palo Alto Networks已拥有Chronosphere及独立遥测管道；自动修复整合当时仍是计划。这使采购主体及分销组合成为实质竞争路线。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 应修订的是谁控制共用数据、供应商组合和运维预算，而非直接给Observe添加SIEM收入。安全平台的统一销售可能截留运维份额，客户对中立数据基础的偏好也可能提供另一条参与路径。

possibility_space.name: 安全负责人将可观测性纳入统一平台采购
possibility_space.implication: 监控工具选择从SRE单独比较变为跨部门组合与共享管道决策，Observe即使技术不变也面临预算控制权外移。竞争可在正式迁移前改变未来可获配空间。

possibility_space.name: 企业共建中立遥测湖而保持安全与事故工具独立
possibility_space.implication: Observe可争取共享数据处理、上下文或运维查询，同时安全检测留在别的系统；邻接数据量扩大不代表它获得完整安全工具预算。

possibility_space.name: 跨产品整合或职责冲突促使客户保留专业运维平台
possibility_space.implication: 统一供应商的采购优势可能被实施和运营摩擦抵销，Observe的中立性和专业工作流相对更有价值。受益来自客户架构选择，不是收购本身自动带来的对手失单。

shells.name: 平台经营经济与公司资本
shells.scope: Snowflake消费型平台及相邻业务的交付成本、人员和研发销售投入、经营盈利、合同结算、现金回收与再投资，以及公司流动性、融资、股份与资本配置。共享背景为经营模型、财务报表及附注、合同现金日历、股权薪酬、债务与股份结算；经营盈利、现金转换和资本权益是三个独立维护对象。
shells.boundary: 本域深度拥有公司财务及投入经济性，包括云和AI资源成本、各业务组合的利润影响、账单回款与营运资本、资本开支、收购资金与整合投入、债务和每股权益。产品需求、使用、竞争及资源可交付性归企业数据与AI平台市场域或可观测性与遥测软件域。股权薪酬的费用经济性归经营盈利对象，非现金调整与现金回收归现金转换对象，股份结算及权益变化归资本结构对象。

units.name: 平台交付成本与经营盈利性
units.scope: Snowflake平台的第三方云、模型推理、GPU及其他服务交付成本，产品组合与定价对应的毛利经济性，以及研发、销售、人员和股权薪酬等投入、费用效率与GAAP及调整后经营结果。包含核心平台和相邻业务对整体经营经济性的贡献。
units.horizon: 季度经营结果和年度投入预算周期，兼顾多年度资源采购与盈利结构演变。

expectation_baseline.name: 费用杠杆先于GAAP盈利兑现
expectation_baseline.baseline: 当前采用“增长支撑费用率改善、AI交付投入压制毛利”的工作基线：Q2产品收入增长36.8%，研发和销售费用仍增长但慢于收入，GAAP经营亏损收窄。管理层全年产品收入60.70亿美元、调整后经营利润率14.5%和产品毛利率74%构成公司侧路径，不是同口径卖方共识。SBC待确认约38亿美元、确认期2.6年，使调整后改善向GAAP利润转换仍需多年投入纪律；内部AI使用可助效率，但不作为已实现大幅裁员节约。
expectation_baseline.ordinary_progress: 新工作负载和存量扩展继续摊薄组织投入，模型/云资源采购与内部AI改进逐步抵销部分交付压力。
expectation_baseline.open_frontier: 独立AI收入与贡献率、有效价格和人才报酬决定毛利压力是组合过渡还是结构性；公司FY2028 Q4 GAAP盈利目标保留为管理层陈述，未升级为保证或市场共识。
expectation_baseline.time_scope: FY2027季度至FY2028投入和盈利路径

expectation_baseline.name: 效率收益需要在客户、平台与供应商间重新分配
expectation_baseline.baseline: 工作判断是采购和模型技术持续提供降本工具，但节省不会全部留给Snowflake：AI_COMPLETE响应缓存命中已免计费，说明效率同时减少供应消耗和客户收费。长期最低采购和区域治理使总成本调整慢于部分任务资源下降，因此不采用行业token降价即公司毛利率等幅上升的路径。
expectation_baseline.ordinary_progress: 在现有功能范围内扩大重复任务缓存、模型选择及资源利用率优化，同时增加可负担的新任务。
expectation_baseline.open_frontier: 缓存可覆盖任务比例、客户任务复杂度、合同抵扣及节省传递比例决定净贡献；其规模尚不能由账户数或外部50%批处理折扣推出。
expectation_baseline.time_scope: 未来数季度至多年云采购周期

realization_factors.name: 业务价值、工作负载分配与组合贡献
realization_factors.mechanism: 企业采用数据和AI任务，首先取决于其能否节约分析/工程时间、提高业务决策及时性，以及预算负责人是否愿意支付。任务价值和预算决定可服务活动规模，数据位置、治理和竞争方案决定由哪个引擎执行；Snowflake获得的付费资源量再乘以有效价格形成收入。核心数据、AI、Postgres和遥测的收入权重与各自贡献率共同决定组合毛利，而非任务数或账户数直接决定。客户将已有credits转用于Observe可能改变毛利组合但不增加合同现金；竞争打包或开放引擎降低切换成本后，平台也可能以折扣让出部分降本收益。只有新增贡献毛利超过额外研发销售支持，收入增长才形成经营杠杆。
realization_factors.current_status: 现阶段付费消费扩张是较强的公司观察，AI活跃账户和迁移案例支持任务入口扩展；管理层明确AI贡献率较低，且未给独立AI收入桥。Indeed/Wix语义案例支持减少重建指标的使用价值，Microsoft/Databricks的商业路线使客户可选择替代执行位置。工作判断是公司已获得增长、但增长的单位利润低于纯核心平台扩张；并非已经证明竞争失单或AI无价值。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 付费任务规模和平台获配覆盖产品收入14.919亿美元，是长期利润规模的上游大变量；具体竞争者总量增长不构成Snowflake份额损失。有效价格对同样资源有直接杠杆：假设全部产品有效价下降1%、资源成本不变，当季毛利约减少1492万美元，之后量增才可能抵销。组合权重和贡献率要联合看：假设10个百分点收入从原业务转至低20个百分点贡献率的新业务，固定产品收入下毛利约少2984万美元；此为敏感度例子，不是已披露AI比例。现有non-GAAP产品毛利率74.7%同比降1.7个百分点，说明组合/成本压力目前比单纯账户增长更能解释利润转化。固定组织投入的摊薄滞后数季，短期每一新增低毛利任务仍可增加绝对毛利，不能把毛利率下降等同负贡献。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 拥有业务价值、客户选择到公司毛利和费用的传导；相邻Shell深度研究产品采用和计算获配。本Factor不替代其需求模型，不将全部产品收入当AI收入，也不把公司指引当市场要求。

realization_factors.name: 采购价格、资源利用与承诺成本底座
realization_factors.mechanism: 云厂商控制硬件代际、资源费率和地区供给；Snowflake控制工作负载迁移、预留规模及调度。在容量可共享、技术可替换时，单位算力价格下降和利用率提升降低每单位交付成本。客户要求本地推理、隔离和权限边界时，可互换资源池缩小、重复容量及支持底座上升。多年协议的年度最低额使成本对实际用量呈非线性：低于最低额时进一步省资源未必等额省当期采购现金，跨过最低额后新增用量才更多体现边际成本；补差可用于后续合资格服务又使短期浪费与最终经济损失不同。未来业务规模越匹配承诺，采购议价和投入摊薄越可能形成优势。
realization_factors.current_status: 产品成本约75%是第三方云/AI/GPU及地区部署，上年约70%；这使资源路径直接接触主要交付成本。现有五年60亿美元协议各合同年最低额9亿至12.5亿美元，未完成须补差且可抵后续合资格消费。跨地区推理受客户路由设置约束，不能以另一地区充裕容量替代本地资格。当前判断是公司承担真实长期利用责任，尚不足以断言闲置或已获得行业标价降幅；采购承诺不等于物理GPU储备。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 资源价格和资源量共同决定云成本；按Q2产品成本4.344亿美元×75%估算相关交付云成本约3.258亿美元。假设该成本净下降5%、收入及其他成本不变，可增加当季利润约1629万美元、相当总收入1.05个百分点；这是规模基准，不是采购预测。利用率通过同一成本池起作用，不能再把它当与价格节省完全独立的增益。年度最低额决定低利用状态下现金/利润敏感度，年度9亿至12.5亿美元的约束远大于单一小功能成本；具体适用资源与已有消费决定是否紧约束。地区隔离主要降低池化范围和提高启动固定成本，现有披露未量化占比，其边际影响在新地区低负载时最大。硬件迁移速度决定节省兑现时滞，安全和本地资格决定哪些负载根本不能迁移，二者不能由标价比较省略。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 涵盖产品交付资源经济性和安全治理带来的资源碎片化；研发用途云成本在组织投入Factor补充。合同实际付款和预付在现金Unit解释，区域可交付产品及订单由相邻Shell拥有。

realization_factors.name: 成功任务成本、缓存与效率收益分配
realization_factors.mechanism: AI任务由输入上下文、输出推理、工具轮次和失败重试组成；成功率决定这些资源分摊到多少完成任务。模型选择与提示缓存降低特定输入成本，响应缓存则可能直接避免重复推理。异步批处理可交换时延获得更低资源价格，但不适合所有交互任务。采购净价决定Snowflake支付多少，客户计费规则决定节省归谁；成本下降同时免收客户费时，毛利率与绝对毛利不必同向。更便宜可靠的任务又能扩大可负担使用，形成量的反弹；任务转向长上下文和多轮代理会抵销部分每token降价。
realization_factors.current_status: 9月29日已发布AI_COMPLETE响应缓存，当前技术范围是同一查询的相同文本调用，命中免计费且非保证；这是一条明确的成本和收入同时减少路径，不能外推到所有Cortex调用。AWS部分模型批推理已有相对按需50%价格机制，支持时延换成本的可行性，但不是公司现行采购折扣。当前最有用的解释是“效率扩大可服务任务，并重分配已有收费”，而不是“外部模型价跌必然提高公司利润”。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 任务数量设置AI机会规模，但目前AI收入权重不明，故不能把本机制套到全部产品收入。输入/输出长度、轮次和重试率决定资源强度，在成功率低的工作流中其影响可大于标价变化：若每次尝试成本不变而成功率从80%降至40%，每成功任务尝试成本约翻倍；仅是条件示例。缓存命中和批处理适用比例限制节省覆盖面，不能将公布的50%或90%节省乘全体AI成本。采购价和客户费率决定平台保留比例，响应命中免计费使客户收益明确、公司绝对毛利收益不确定。使用反弹的幅度与时滞由任务价值和预算决定；当前比起推定净反弹系数，区分可复用批任务与实时复杂agent更有解释力。该变量可显著改变AI增量利润结构，但现有全公司利润贡献仍无法精确量化。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 研究AI交付单位经济和价格传递，不把外部API标价当公司成本，不以任务完成率假设替代客户实际数据；跨接企业AI需求Unit的任务形态。

realization_factors.name: 组织产出、人才报酬与研发前置投入
realization_factors.mechanism: 收入扩张能否摊薄人员费用，取决于业务产出/员工、所需人数和每人总报酬三个不同变量。内部编程、分析和支持自动化可使相同团队承接更多任务；管理层若把省时继续用于研发，则产出提高但费用未必下降。竞争模型公司抬高技术人才机会成本，会通过现金薪酬、刷新股权及留任安排抵销人数效率。SBC按授予和归属确认，使费用路径受历史授予存量与新授予共同影响，非当前股价涨幅一比一重估所有奖励。研发云/推理/GPU投入往往先于商业收入，形成与人员无关的费用前置；招聘、自动化和产品迭代共同决定费用率的跨季变化。
realization_factors.current_status: 已观察到研发与销售费用增速低于收入，而非费用绝对下降。CFO称内部BI采购被CoCo替代，提供自动化用途但未提供全公司节约额。外部Meta明确把2026薪酬增加联系到AI人才，说明人才竞争在运作，并非Snowflake已按相同比例加薪。公司未确认奖励费用约38亿美元、加权确认期2.6年，使GAAP与调整后利润的差距有持续底座；研发云成本的增长又说明不能只用人数增长解释研发费用。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 人数和产出决定规模杠杆，单位报酬和授予决定节省能否保留。按10-Q非SBC人员费用约占总成本费用37%及Q2总成本费用约18.098亿美元估算，该费用池约6.70亿美元；假设净节省5%，季度约3348万美元、总收入约2.16个百分点，说明组织效率潜在杠杆大于一个小产品毛利变化。此费用池包含佣金，不能与销售Factor节省重复相加。Q2纯SBC费用4.236亿美元约为研发费用的75%量级比较，但分布于多个科目，不能全部归研发；其5%变动约2118万美元且主要影响GAAP。研发5.675亿美元的同比增加约7547万美元，其中披露云资源增加约4250万美元，是目前独立于人数的重要增量。自动化采用范围和转为少招人的管理决策决定兑现时间；人才竞价与历史授予压制短期费用骤降，故现阶段收入扩张领先费用、而非绝对成本削减，是较强解释。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 拥有人员、研发云投入和SBC的费用经济性；股权归属税款现金与股份分母在其他Unit分别研究。内部软件取消不等于客户取消合同，也不将外部人才个案直接量化成公司薪酬。

realization_factors.name: 销售渠道、迁移实施与获客回收
realization_factors.mechanism: 客户采购由财务、技术和业务负责人共同决定；渠道联合销售可复用云商预算承诺、客户关系及实施伙伴，降低采购与迁移摩擦。Snowflake实际销售回报取决于销售覆盖、转化率、迁移到生产的速度、消费扩展和净贡献，不只是签约额度。云市场收费、第三方介绍费、销售佣金及折扣可能随交易增长，抵销人数效率；部分佣金先资本化、再按受益期摊销，使当期费用改善与现金付款不同。专业服务可亏损帮助客户投产，经济回收在后续产品贡献，不能独立按服务毛利判定价值。
realization_factors.current_status: AWS合作包含联合迁移和客户成功；同时10-Q明确渠道交易费用、佣金及收购无形摊销推动销售费用增长。Q2销售费用6.116亿美元同比约22%，慢于收入约35%；销售人数4427、上年4047，说明当前既有扩张也有杠杆。专业服务收入约5493万美元、毛利率约负38%，是实施补贴性质的重要边界。管理层所述迁移从10—11个月缩至约6个月只支持加快投产的路径，不证明全部获客成本已下降。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 销售人数与单位报酬决定固定覆盖成本；转化率、上线速度和后续留存决定这笔投入跨季回收，失效项目可使同样支出没有消费收益。佣金/介绍费Q2同比增加约5470万美元，接近销售费用增量1.097亿美元的一半，目前交易相关成本不可忽略。渠道费和折扣降低净捕获，联合投入则降低公司自行承担的获客成本，两者须净额理解。服务毛利率虽为负，收入只占总收入约3.6%，以其同比再恶化10个百分点作静态例子，季度毛利影响约549万美元，显著小于全部销售效率5%的约3058万美元；但迁移延误影响后续产品回收可能更大。资本化和摊销主要改变确认时点，不能与经营生产率混为一种结构性节省。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 本Unit拥有获客、实施补贴和费用回收；需求和渠道新增项目规模由相邻Shell深度研究。佣金现金与摊销错位在现金Unit补充，渠道分成未披露时不构造净费率。

realization_factors.name: 并购复用、持续投入与会计利润桥
realization_factors.mechanism: 收购使团队、产品和客户进入合并范围；共享数据、云基础设施和销售覆盖可以降低重复投入，但新地域、不同SRE或数据库工作流又可能要求独立研发、支持和可靠性投入。整合进度决定协同发生快慢，留任需求决定人才成本，收入并表本身不创造协同。对价分配形成无形资产摊销和商誉，前者压低后续GAAP利润而非同期经营付款，后者在回报不达预期时可能减值；调整后排除这些科目不等于原先资本投入没有经济成本。
realization_factors.current_status: Observe和Natoma已并表，初步对价约5.958亿和1.283亿美元；产品经济仍未分部披露。Observe可用既有credits采购支持渠道复用，但也可能只是原额度重新分配。Q2经营利润GAAP约负2.630亿美元、non-GAAP约正2.370亿美元，差约5亿美元，其中股权相关费用和约4220万美元收购无形摊销是主要项。当前应把收入增长与整合效率分开，而非假定并购已经低成本成熟。
realization_factors.materiality_context: 被收购业务收入规模决定潜在协同覆盖面，当前缺独立贡献故不能给Observe利润权重。重复组织与共享平台节省影响经常性费用，留任支出与新增可靠性研发可抵销，整合时滞决定成本前置持续几季。4220万美元季度摊销已相当总收入约2.7个百分点，是GAAP—调整后桥中实质但小于股权相关费用4.564亿美元的部分；不能让摊销叙事遮住更大人员经济。商誉/减值对账面利润可大而即时CFO影响通常非同额，投资回报应以未来净现金而非排除项后的利润判断。当前整合贡献的不确定性大于可确认为零或完全成功的证据，不妨碍保持这些独立成本关系。
realization_factors.scope_boundary: 拥有整合投入和利润口径，资本Unit拥有收购资金及回报，产品与客户演变属于相邻业务Shell。

potential_gaps.name: AI任务经济与效率收益捕获
potential_gaps.why_live: AI组合扩大伴随产品毛利承压，独立AI贡献率仍未披露。响应缓存已经存在且命中免计费，外部模型有缓存/批处理降本路径；客户又可选择模型、执行引擎及更复杂代理任务。因此“更多AI使用”并非单一利润方向，当前74.7%调整后产品毛利率与74%全年公司指引只定位组合结果，不能确定谁保留未来节省。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 现有基线是增长支持费用杠杆而交付成本约束毛利。修订的核心是每个成功任务的净贡献以及新任务与旧收入替代的关系：供应效率、客户费率、任务复杂度和产品组合可以分别变化。新的模型或客户采购决定即使早于财报，也可改变对增量利润和增长持续性的解释；不把外部价格降幅机械套成公司毛利改善。

possibility_space.name: 模型商扩大可商用小模型和批处理，平台保留部分净降本
possibility_space.implication: 适合异步处理或标准化任务的采购成本下降快于有效收费，AI增量贡献改善；覆盖范围受模型质量、时延和采购条款限制，不能外推至实时复杂agent或全部产品。

possibility_space.name: 客户把大量重复处理迁入免计费缓存路径
possibility_space.implication: 同样业务任务减少推理和收费资源，客户成本下降而既有绝对毛利可能减少；若低成本使新任务大量进入，随后可重新扩大贡献。短期收入放缓可与产品价值增强并存。

possibility_space.name: 业务部门把分析助手升级成长上下文、多轮执行代理
possibility_space.implication: 企业愿付价值可能提升，但每成功任务的输出、工具轮次及重试成本增加，token标价下降不保证贡献改善。可靠性提高减少重试时又能抵销一部分资源强度，判断重心转向成功任务经济。

possibility_space.name: 云商和竞争平台以打包折扣争夺企业AI预算
possibility_space.implication: Snowflake可服务需求仍在，保留客户却需要让利，净收入/资源与组合贡献可能低于原先路径；若客户为治理和已有数据整合支付溢价，价值可仍留在平台，不能仅由对手增长断言流失。

possibility_space.name: 客户将AI用于新增业务流程而非只替代既有查询
possibility_space.implication: 即使AI毛利率较低，新贡献和连带数据工作负载可超过被替代消费，经营利润总量改善可快于毛利率恢复；反之仅在同一credit承诺内重配用途，更接近组合变化而非新增利润池。

potential_gaps.name: 云采购优势与承诺刚性的分岔
potential_gaps.why_live: 云/AI/GPU及地区部署约占产品成本75%，多年协议又有年度最低支出和补差责任。行业硬件降价、公司迁移与区域路由限制并不同步；补差可抵后续服务使短期资金占用和最终资源损失不等价。当前没有证实闲置，也不能认定公司已得到行业同幅降价。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 相对于采购和规模优化逐步抵销毛利压力的基线，未来关键变化是可用资源能否在合适期限内被经济地使用。硬件价格、承诺可调剂性及地区资源池决定净成本，而非60亿美元名义承诺本身。按现有交付云成本池的5%变化可达约1629万美元季度利润敏感度作规模参照，非预测或触发线。

possibility_space.name: 云商开放更高性价比资源并允许既有承诺迁移
possibility_space.implication: 公司不必重复采购即可降低相同业务量成本，长期承诺从刚性支出转为议价优势；节省兑现速度由技术迁移与合资格负载决定。

possibility_space.name: 客户优化或模型效率减少资源使用，合同最低额保持
possibility_space.implication: 同样业务价值使用更少资源，但最低额使采购现金不能同步下降；短期毛利与现金改善可能弱于技术效率，未来合资格消费用掉抵扣后可追回部分利益。

possibility_space.name: 大客户收窄跨区推理并要求独立本地部署
possibility_space.implication: 需求不必消失，却需要更多低利用资源池、支持和工程底座，规模效应减弱；这是地区治理导致的成本变化，不是把未证实安全指控当平台损失。

possibility_space.name: 供应商放宽跨服务、合同年或地区的抵扣安排
possibility_space.implication: 同样总需求更容易消化采购最低额，降低闲置与补差风险，单位成本可改善而收入未必立即变化；若放宽只覆盖很少模型或地区，其影响局限于相应池。

potential_gaps.name: 内部AI组织化与人才报酬的净杠杆
potential_gaps.why_live: 内部CoCo仪表盘替代已有软件采购提供真实用途；公司研发和销售费用增速已慢于收入，但费用绝对额仍增长。外部AI人才竞价、约38亿美元待确认奖励和研发云资源前置投入，使“AI省时”与“费用减少”之间保留重要管理选择。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 当前较强解释是收入扩张领先费用，而非绝对降本。若公司把自动化变成少招人、少外包或减少重复软件，费用曲线可进一步下移；若省时被再投入产品或被人才总报酬抵销，近期杠杆弱而长期产出可能更强。需要修订的是GAAP及调整后盈利路径，不能将客户迁移省时直接当公司节约。

possibility_space.name: 管理层以内部agent重做支持、工程和分析流程，并限制新增招聘
possibility_space.implication: 同样增长由较小增量团队承接，经常工资与外部软件支出降低，规模杠杆不再只依赖高收入增速；历史股权费用存量仍会延后GAAP改善。

possibility_space.name: 产品团队把节约工时投入更多模型、区域和可靠性研发
possibility_space.implication: 当期费用率降幅可能较小，研发云成本甚至增加；这可提高未来产品机会，不能把未裁员或当季成本未降直接解读为自动化无效。

possibility_space.name: 模型公司和竞争平台集中争夺核心工程人才
possibility_space.implication: 留任奖金、刷新授予和单位员工总报酬增加，即使人数受控也削弱利润杠杆；影响现金薪酬与SBC的时序不同，并可与自动化同时发生。

possibility_space.name: 公司改变新授予规模和现金股权组合，而旧奖励逐渐归属
possibility_space.implication: 减少刷新股权可使未来GAAP费用和潜在股份下降，但若以现金补偿替代，经营现金负担上升；若减少总报酬导致关键人才流失，则研发交付与收入回收也可能受损。

potential_gaps.name: 渠道与实施方式重构销售回收
potential_gaps.why_live: 联合迁移和Marketplace能降低采购摩擦，但销售费用中佣金、渠道交易费及收购摊销也在增加；专业服务毛利为负，收益主要依赖客户随后持续产品消费。当前销售费用杠杆与较大获客投入同时存在。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 以销售投入被持续消费逐步摊薄为工作参照，未来采购和实施分工的变化可改变同样收入所需的净销售成本和回收时间。加快签约、加快投产、改善留存及减少公司承担费用是不同变化，不能由渠道累计交易额替代。

possibility_space.name: 云商承担更多客户成功和迁移投入，客户通过自助采购上线
possibility_space.implication: Snowflake获得相同消费所需的自行销售与服务补贴下降，费用回收提前；前提是云商承担投入而不是以更大公司折扣结算，净收益不能由渠道订单额直接推出。

possibility_space.name: 云渠道提高交易收费或伙伴要求更多获客分成
possibility_space.implication: 采购量可继续增长，但佣金、渠道费和有效折扣吸收更多毛利，销售人数效率未必形成同幅利润改善。

possibility_space.name: 系统集成商把迁移工具化并接过实施工作
possibility_space.implication: 公司负毛利服务投入可能减少、客户投产更快；若伙伴通过高实施价格挤占后续消费预算，短期省服务成本与长期产品回收可能相抵。

possibility_space.name: 客户暂停一批迁移项目但公司保留销售覆盖
possibility_space.implication: 工资、前期佣金和迁移支持不能立即收回，费用回收拉长，即使已签合同或RPO不大幅减少也可能削弱经营利润；后续重启则先改善资产回收而非新增获客。

potential_gaps.name: 相邻业务扩张的协同与持续投入边界
potential_gaps.why_live: Observe和Natoma已并表，数据库与遥测有不同客户和可靠性工作流；共同credits和平台接口提供复用入口，却未形成独立利润贡献桥。GAAP与调整后经营结果差距中既有股权费用，也有已存在的收购摊销。
potential_gaps.revision_logic: 现有基线允许增长摊薄组织成本，但不能假定并表即协同。未来整合选择决定相邻业务是复用平台提高经营效率、长期维持独立投入，还是需要收缩和重估；修订对象是经常性费用与GAAP利润路径，而非单看排除摊销后的增长。

possibility_space.name: 公司统一云采购、销售覆盖和后台，保留必要产品团队
possibility_space.implication: 重复投入下降，使新增业务贡献更快覆盖自身成本；若客户只是在既有credits内转用产品，成本复用可能先于净新增收入体现。

possibility_space.name: 客户要求独立SRE、事务可靠性和跨云部署，子业务继续扩团队
possibility_space.implication: 业务需求可获支持，但组织与基础设施不能按最初设想共享，投入期和较低组合利润可能延长；不能将所有额外成本归成一次性整合。

possibility_space.name: 管理层停止部分产品整合或关闭低回报项目
possibility_space.implication: 一次性减值、重组或留任结算可压低GAAP利润，同时减少未来经常现金投入；账面损失不等于当季同额经营烧钱，也不抹去原收购资本成本。
